阅读来源：PDF 全文抽取
brief.motivation: 现有 agent harness 多依赖手工规则、固定阈值或全局工作流，难以根据任务、环境和执行状态动态决定是否追加推理、修正工作流或结束任务。在长链执行中，这会累积成重复思考、纠错延迟和额外工具调用，甚至因不必要的干预降低成功率。论文的核心问题是：如何只在预期收益足够时干预 agent 的当前工作流，同时压低 token 与时间成本并尽量保持任务成功。
brief.method: CHILL-Harness 将当前工作流作为事实基线，把候选工作流视为同一执行状态下的反事实干预。CIEL 通过恢复相同检查点、分别执行事实与候选分支，学习候选相对基线的效用差，并将干预分解为保留、追加思考、检查或验证、去重或停滞恢复、答案整合等类型；CDE、CRE 和 CAE 分别控制推理深度、是否替换工作流以及是否具备完成证据。ARCO 先选择 Skip、Light 或 Full 推理路线，再生成和过滤候选，并且只有当修正预测与优势裕量同时支持替换时才执行候选，否则保留原工作流；终止还必须通过显式任务验证器。其所谓“因果”主要建立在同状态检查点配对回放及状态充分性、分支隔离等假设上，更接近受控反事实比较，并非无条件成立的因果识别。
brief.experiments: 论文在 GAIA、SWE-bench Verified 和 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上评测，分别覆盖信息检索、代码修复和终端交互。报告结果显示，CHILL-Harness 在三个基准上的成功率分别为 71.3%、65.6% 和 56.1%，总 token 相比各组最低 token 的公开基线分别下降 28.4%、13.1% 和 23.1%；运行时间相对最快的合格基线分别下降 46.6%、25.9% 和 2.6%。在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上，其成功率低于 LemonHarness 的 57.4%，说明它并非全面支配已有系统，而是以更高 token 效率进入成功率—效率前沿。Always-Full 消融在 GAIA 和 SWE-bench Verified 上同时增加成本并显著降低成功率，在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上也增加大量规划开销而几乎没有收益，较有力地支持了“先判断推理深度、再生成候选”的设计；但论文没有完整拆分 CIEL、CRE、CAE、优势估计及授权约束，也未给出方差、置信区间或显著性检验。
brief.research_help: Insight：对 agent planning 最可迁移的启发，是把“要不要重新规划”视为一个有成本且可能有害的决策，而不是每一步都默认增加推理。多轮与 long-horizon 系统可以将保留当前计划、轻量检查、完整重规划、恢复停滞和答案收束建模成分层控制动作，并在昂贵候选生成之前进行路由。可靠性方面，工作流替换应同时满足可执行性、显式证据、相对优势裕量和成功保护条件，任务终止也不应仅凭模型自报完成。对于 agentic RL，这提示奖励或价值模型应同时刻画任务成功、推理成本和“破坏原本可成功轨迹”的非对称风险；不过本文主要是离线弱监督和效应预测，并不是标准的在线强化学习方法。

analysis.limitations: 第一，因果效应依赖检查点完整保存所有相关状态、反事实分支互不干扰以及后续协议一致，这些假设在真实工具环境中可能被隐藏状态、随机 API 和不可逆操作破坏。第二，CIEL 的多项决策由轨迹结果构造弱监督标签，标签规则、训练数据规模、分布以及效应估计的校准质量在所给文本中披露不足。第三，外部基线可能使用不同的 harness 结构与工程优化；即使基础模型、工具和资源在作者的配对实验中受控，公开系统之间仍不能直接视为严格因果比较。第四，消融主要验证 Always-Full，没有分别移除效应学习、CRE、CAE、操作效用、授权裕量及成功保护损失，无法判断各组件的独立贡献。第五，没有报告多次运行方差、置信区间、统计显著性、失败类型分解或分布外测试；Terminal-Bench 2.0 的时间改善很小且成功率并非最高。第六，论文使用 deepseek-v4-flash 和 deepseek-v4-pro 等配置，模型及复现实验条件需要结合公开代码、权重或 API 可用性进一步核验。
source_evidence: 正文将当前工作流定义为零效应事实基线，并以同一执行上下文中的候选工作流效用差定义干预效果。
CIEL 明确分为工作流效应估计、干预类型预测，以及 CDE、CRE、CAE 三个决策头；ARCO 在候选生成前选择 Skip、Light 或 Full 路线。
算法规定候选必须先通过可接受工作流集合过滤，并同时满足 CRE 的 Change 判断和干预相关优势裕量，才能替换事实工作流。
任务终止同时依赖 CAE 的完成预测与显式任务验证器，而不是只依靠模型认为任务已经完成。调整效率的弱监督只在任务成功得到保持时提供正向信号。定义的轨迹损失还专门惩罚把参考成功轨迹变成失败的干预。主结果表报告三个基准上的 token 消耗均低于各组最低 token 公开基线，但 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上 CHILL-Harness 的成功率低...

items.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
items.summary: We introduce Kimi K3, a 2.8T parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 104 billion activated parameters, native vision capabilities, and a 1-million-token context window. Kimi K3 is built on Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals, which improve information flow across sequence length and model depth. Together with Stable LatentMoE, which effectively activates 16 of 896 routed experts per token, and refined training and data recipes, these advances yield an approximately 2.5x improvement in overall scaling efficiency over Kimi K2. Post-training highlights reinforcement learning across general, agentic, and coding domains and multiple reasoning-effort levels, enabling compositional generalization and robust long-horizon execution. At 2.8T scale, Kimi K3 is supported by infrastructure advances in multiple areas: algorithm-system co-design for KDA, perfectly balanced expert-parallel training with efficient memory management, million-token agentic RL with persistent rollout and sandbox states, and deployment innovations. Extensive evaluations show that Kimi K3 achieves frontier-level performance across long-horizon coding, agentic, knowledge, reasoning, and vision tasks. While its overall performance still trails the most powerful proprietary models, namely Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol, Kimi K3 consistently outperforms other open and proprietary models evaluated in our suite. We release the full Kimi K3 model weights to facilitate future research and accelerate the broader deployment and adoption of frontier intelligence.

brief.summary: Kimi K3 试图解决开放模型只扩展推理时计算、却没有同步扩展预训练基础的问题，并把目标直接指向百万 token、多轮工具使用和长时程任务执行。其核心是一个 2.8T 参数的原生多模态 MoE，结合混合线性—全局注意力、跨层注意力残差和稳定化的稀疏专家机制。后训练将三个领域与三种推理强度分别进行 RL，再用多教师 on-policy 蒸馏合并，同时依靠可恢复 rollout、持久 KV cache 和可恢复微型虚拟机承载超长轨迹。实验给出了较强的编程、搜索、自动化和视觉智能体表现，并显示增加 RL 计算量时能力与执行步数共同增长。它对 agent planning 最有价值的部分是长轨迹训练基础设施、预算控制与 harness 多样化，而不是单纯的模型规模纪录。由于所给文本不完整，且若干证据来自内部评测或不完全一致的模型配置，论文关于稳健长程规划的强结论仍需更细的失败分析和外部复现。

偏水风险：中
阅读来源：PDF 全文抽取
brief.motivation: 论文认为，开放模型近年的进步更多来自推理时计算、强化学习和多智能体协作，而预训练模型规模增长相对停滞，可能导致其与最强闭源系统的差距扩大。Kimi K3 因此同时扩展预训练基础、推理强度和长时程交互，目标是在百万 token 上下文中支持数百至数千次工具调用，并提高复杂任务的持续执行能力。
brief.method: 模型采用总参数 2.8T、激活参数 104B 的稀疏 MoE 架构，以 Kimi Delta Attention 与周期性全局注意力处理超长序列，以 Attention Residuals 改善跨层信息访问，并用 Stable LatentMoE、SiTU-GLU 和 Quantile Balancing 稳定极稀疏专家训练。后训练先用 SFT 建立工具调用与长轨迹能力，再分别针对通用任务、通用智能体和编程智能体，在 low、high、max 三种推理强度下进行 RL，最后通过多教师 on-policy 蒸馏合并九个专家策略。其 agentic RL 系统支持跨训练迭代暂停和恢复轨迹、保留外部 KV cache 与沙箱状态，并使用多种可组合的工具、记忆、上下文管理及智能体框架配置，降低对单一 harness 的过拟合。
brief.experiments: 论文报告 Kimi K3 在长时程编程、搜索、自动化、专业工作流、视觉工具使用和一般推理等评测上达到开放模型前沿，并在作者所列多数模型中领先，但总体仍落后于最强闭源模型。给出的主要信号包括：随着 RL 计算量增加，多个任务的成绩与平均工具调用步数同步上升；DeepSWE、SWE-Marathon、BrowseComp 和 AutomationBench 等结果显示较强的长程执行能力；架构与训练配方相对 Kimi K2 带来约 2.5 倍的总体 scaling efficiency。需要谨慎的是，部分结果来自内部基准，比较条件包含不同推理预算、潜在 fallback 或安全机制，而且所提供文本在任务合成章节中途截断，无法核查报告后续的完整消融、方差、失败案例和独立复现证据。
brief.research_help: Insight：长时程 agentic RL 的关键不只是扩大上下文或增加工具调用，而是同时保存模型状态与环境状态，让未完成轨迹能够跨更新周期继续运行。将任务领域与推理预算解耦训练，再通过多教师 on-policy 蒸馏统一，可以作为构造可控成本、多能力 agent 策略的通用路线。可组合的 harness 随机化说明，planning reliability 应在工具接口、系统提示、记忆和上下文管理变化下训练与评测，避免策略只记住单一执行框架。论文还提示不能把更长轨迹直接等同于更可靠规划：需要结合可验证环境、长度约束、阶段性检查以及失败恢复机制，才能判断额外步骤是否真正改善结果。

brief.card_summary: Kimi K3 是一份同时扩展超大规模 MoE、百万 token 上下文和长时程 agentic RL 的综合技术报告，尤其值得关注其可恢复轨迹、持久沙箱状态和跨 harness 训练设计。结果显示它在多项编程与智能体评测上具有很强竞争力，但内部基准、比较条件差异和有限的可靠性消融，使部分结论仍需独立验证。

analysis.full_summary: Kimi K3 试图解决开放模型只扩展推理时计算、却没有同步扩展预训练基础的问题，并把目标直接指向百万 token、多轮工具使用和长时程任务执行。其核心是一个 2.8T 参数的原生多模态 MoE，结合混合线性—全局注意力、跨层注意力残差和稳定化的稀疏专家机制。后训练将三个领域与三种推理强度分别进行 RL，再用多教师 on-policy 蒸馏合并，同时依靠可恢复 rollout、持久 KV cache 和可恢复微型虚拟机承载超长轨迹。实验给出了较强的编程、搜索、自动化和视觉智能体表现，并显示增加 RL 计算量时能力与执行步数共同增长。它对 agent planning 最有价值的部分是长轨迹训练基础设施、预算控制与 harness 多样化，而不是单纯的模型规模纪录。由于所给文本不完整，且若干证据来自内部评测或不完全一致的模型配置，论文关于稳健长程规划的强结论仍需更细的失败分析和外部复现。
analysis.value_label: 长时程 Agentic RL 核心参考
analysis.value_reason: 与关注方向高度相关：不仅讨论 agentic RL，还具体覆盖百万 token 轨迹、跨迭代恢复、持久环境状态、多工具 harness、推理预算控制和多教师策略合并，技术信息密度明显高于普通模型发布稿。偏水风险不能评为低，因为它仍是一份模型团队自述的综合技术报告，若干领先结论依赖内部基准或比较条件不完全一致，而且现有材料不足以确认规划失败率、长轨迹收益归因和完整消融。
analysis.limitations: 提供材料虽标记为 full_text，但实际文本在第 4.2.2 节中途截断，因此这里是对所提供正文片段的全文级阅读，而不是对完整 PDF 所有章节的核查。现有片段没有充分展示长时程任务的成功率随轨迹长度变化、错误累积与恢复率、不同记忆或上下文策略的独立消融，也难以区分性能提升分别来自模型规模、架构、数据、RL 计算量还是测试时预算。部分评测为内部基准，公开基准之间也存在 fallback、安全机制和推理强度等条件差异；“工具调用步数增加”本身不能证明规划可靠性提高。

长时程 RL 采用 partial rollouts：未完成轨迹可暂停、排队，并在后续训练迭代中借助持久沙箱恢复。
系统保留外部 KV cache 和可恢复 microVM 环境状态，用于支持百万 token 的长期智能体轨迹。

items.title: EviBack: Search-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Evidence-Constrained Teacher Backoff
items.summary: Reinforcement learning enables Agentic RAG systems to learn multi-turn search from verifiable outcome rewards, but all- zero rollout groups provide no comparative signal and may hide useful search behavior. We present EviBack, an evidence- constrained Teacher backoff that supplies auxiliary super- vision to such groups while preserving verifiable Actor re- wards. It separates evidence assessment from answer refine- ment, preventing reference answers from overriding evidence- insufficiency judgments. A fully automated, end-to-end GPT- 5.5-assisted APE pipeline starts from a manually authored single-prompt dual-task Teacher, automatically partitions and labels rollout data, and performs ablation, task decomposition, evaluation, and selection to produce a gated two-stage Teacher. Compared with the manual design, the resulting Teacher im- proves downstream F1 and valid-answer rate while reduc- ing search, duplicate queries, and forced termination. Across seven open-domain QA benchmarks and three Qwen3 scales, EviBack improves F1 over Search-R1 and raises both single- and multi-hop macro F1. We guarantee that the code will be made publicly available at a later stage.

recommendation.label: 强相关、方法设计有启发，但实验外推有限
recommendation.value_judgement: 论文直接研究 multi-turn 搜索智能体的强化学习与轨迹可靠性，明确诊断了全零组的学习信号缺失，并给出了选择性回退和证据边界门控这两个可迁移设计。它不是只靠概念包装：包含奖励诊断、Teacher 边界审计、消融实验和配对轨迹分析。不过主要收益集中于特定模型规模和开放域 QA 设置，尚不足以证明对一般 agent planning 或更长时域任务同样有效。

brief.summary: 这篇论文关注搜索智能体强化学习中的一个具体失效点：GRPO 的全零 rollout 组无法形成相对优势，因此部分有效的搜索行为也会被丢弃。EviBack 仅对这些全零组启用弱 Teacher 奖励，并通过先做无参考答案的证据充分性判断、再做有参考答案的答案校准，阻止 Teacher 用金标准答案为不完整证据背书。自动化 E2E-APE 流程负责搜索和冻结 Teacher 的提示及门控策略，而训练后的 Actor 在推理阶段不依赖 Teacher。实验显示相较 Search-R1，三个 Qwen3 规模的 F1 点估计都更高，其中 1.7B 和 4B 的统计信号更明确，1.7B 还显著减少无效结束和重复搜索。阅读价值主要在于“只修复奖励失语区域”以及“把证据边界设为不可覆盖约束”这两项设计，而不是把结果理解为已经解决了一般性的长程规划可靠性。

brief.motivation: 基于 GRPO 的搜索智能体依赖组内相对奖励，但当同一问题的全部 rollout 都未命中精确匹配时，组内优势归零，即使部分轨迹已经找到有用证据，也无法获得学习信号。论文进一步指出，零奖励混合了证据不足、答案生成失败和精确匹配误判等不同情况，因此不能简单等同于“搜索过程完全无价值”。
brief.method: EviBack 只在八条 rollout 全部获得零分时启用 Teacher；只要组内存在可验证命中，就完全保留原始 Actor 奖励。Teacher 分为两阶段：Stage A 在看不到参考答案的情况下判断现有证据是充分、不足还是歧义；仅当 Stage A 未判为证据不足时，Stage B 才使用参考答案校准答案形式，而且不能推翻 Stage A 的不足判断。回退奖励经过组内标准化后再以较小权重加入 GRPO，Teacher 仅用于训练，推理时仍由 Actor 和检索器独立运行。Teacher 的提示、门控和解析流程由 GPT-5.5 辅助的 E2E-APE 自动实验管线产生，最终冻结为 GLM-4.7-Flash Teacher。
brief.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen3 0.6B、1.7B、4B 三种规模和七个开放域问答基准，共评估 3500 个问题。相较 Search-R1，EviBack 在三个规模上的 F1 点估计均提高，但 0.6B 的置信区间跨零，证据明确的提升主要出现在 1.7B 和 4B；1.7B 的 F1 从 0.2509 提升至 0.2911，同时有效答案率上升，平均搜索次数、重复查询率和强制终止率下降。两阶段 Teacher 优于单阶段 Teacher，较弱的回退权重整体最好；不过 4B 模型的平均搜索次数和重复查询率反而增加，说明搜索控制收益不具备跨规模一致性。
brief.research_help: Insight：对 agentic RL，关键不只是增加稠密过程奖励，而是先定位奖励失语的具体状态，再以选择性、低权重的回退信号修复；这比让 Teacher 覆盖全部轨迹更能保护可验证奖励。对多轮搜索与 long-horizon reliability，可将“证据是否足够”设计成不可被答案匹配推翻的安全边界，把继续探索、停止搜索和修正答案分成不同决策。该思路也可迁移到长程规划：只有在整组计划均失败时才启用教师排序，并让教师基于智能体实际观察到的状态判断计划可行性，避免利用终局答案或隐藏信息制造虚假的中间步骤监督。

analysis.full_summary: 这篇论文关注搜索智能体强化学习中的一个具体失效点：GRPO 的全零 rollout 组无法形成相对优势，因此部分有效的搜索行为也会被丢弃。EviBack 仅对这些全零组启用弱 Teacher 奖励，并通过先做无参考答案的证据充分性判断、再做有参考答案的答案校准，阻止 Teacher 用金标准答案为不完整证据背书。自动化 E2E-APE 流程负责搜索和冻结 Teacher 的提示及门控策略，而训练后的 Actor 在推理阶段不依赖 Teacher。实验显示相较 Search-R1，三个 Qwen3 规模的 F1 点估计都更高，其中 1.7B 和 4B 的统计信号更明确，1.7B 还显著减少无效结束和重复搜索。阅读价值主要在于“只修复奖励失语区域”以及“把证据边界设为不可覆盖约束”这两项设计，而不是把结果理解为已经解决了一般性的长程规划可靠性。
analysis.value_label: 强相关、方法设计有启发，但实验外推有限
analysis.value_reason: 论文直接研究 multi-turn 搜索智能体的强化学习与轨迹可靠性，明确诊断了全零组的学习信号缺失，并给出了选择性回退和证据边界门控这两个可迁移设计。它不是只靠概念包装：包含奖励诊断、Teacher 边界审计、消融实验和配对轨迹分析。不过主要收益集中于特定模型规模和开放域 QA 设置，尚不足以证明对一般 agent planning 或更长时域任务同样有效。
analysis.limitations: 训练与评估都只使用各数据集的抽样子集，而非完整基准；置信区间反映问题级 bootstrap，不覆盖不同训练随机种子的方差，表中还是确定性单检查点评估。0.6B 的 F1 改善置信区间跨零，4B 虽提高答案质量，却增加平均搜索次数和重复查询，行为收益并不稳定。Teacher 构建依赖 GPT-5.5 和自动生成标签，论文对这种专有控制器带来的可复现性、标签偏差及替代模型敏感性验证不足；代码也仅承诺稍后公开。任务局限于最多六轮的开放域 QA，因此不能直接据此声称方法已在真正长时域规划、跨任务 agent 或真实网页搜索中成立；摘要所称“16% gain”也需要结合具体指标和设置理解，不能视为普遍的绝对提升。
source_evidence: 方法部分规定每个问题采样八条轨迹，仅当所有轨迹的精确匹配奖励均为零时调用 Teacher；存在任一命中时沿用原始 Actor 奖励。
对 3457 条零奖励轨迹的加权审计显示，64.5% 属于证据不足或歧义，16.7% 是语义正确但精确匹配失败，其余包含错误、部分答案或未闭合答案。
Stage A 不读取参考答案并决定证据充分性；Stage B 仅在 Stage A 非不足时读取参考答案，而且公式明确要求 Stage B 不得推翻不足判断。
表 2 报告 1.7B 设置下 Search-R1 与 EviBack 的 F1 分别为 0.2509 和 0.2911，有效答案率分别为 0.7317 和 0.8611，同时平均搜索与重复查询均下降。对于 4B，F1 从 0.4044 升至 0.4177，但搜索次数从 2.0454 升至 2.4983，重复查询率从 0.1371 升至 0.2480。

items.title: Keep It InMind: Benchmarking the Implicit-Association Blind Spot in Agent Memory
items.summary: Long-term memory systems store what a user says in an external store and retrieve it when a related query arrives. This interface rests on an assumption so natural that it is rarely stated: a memory that is needed will resemble the query that needs it. World knowledge breaks the assumption. A tree-nut allergy should change the answer to a macaron request through their almond-flour ingredient, yet the two texts share no cue a retriever can see. We call this failure mode the implicit-association blind spot and introduce InMind, a 125-task, expert-verified benchmark spanning ten life domains, with 113 tasks grounded in citable public sources. Its paired controls separate three explanations that existing evaluations conflate: the fact was never stored, the model lacks the bridging knowledge, or the fact was stored and never surfaced. The verdict is clean. With the decisive memory placed in context, the backbone answers 84.0 percent of indirect queries; when the same memory must be retrieved, six vector, graph, and agentic memory systems reach at most 14.4 percent, even though they recall the same facts on demand at up to 100 percent. An embedding with eight times the dimensionality raises answer-blind target recall for every system yet leaves the gap essentially intact. A minimal diagnostic probe that keeps memory visible before the query arrives recovers most of the gap, locating the failure in the query-conditioned interface itself and pointing to routing, deciding which facts must stay visible, as the open problem InMind is built to score.

recommendation.label: 值得精读：记忆路由与规划可靠性
recommendation.value_judgement: 论文提出的问题清晰且重要，并用配对控制把“没存住、模型不会、没有送到模型面前”三个常被混淆的原因拆开，实验信号也具有较大且一致的差距。它对 agent memory、长期个性化、多轮决策和安全约束都有直接价值，不只是换模块后比较平均分。不过，其基准主动筛除了容易检索的样本，因此证明的是一个真实而关键的最坏区域，并不能据此断言检索式记忆在一般任务上整体无效；始终可见状态也只是诊断证据，不是已经解决规模、隐私和信息拥挤问题的系统方案。综合来看不像水文，概念、评测和诊断链条都较完整，但论文对“范式级结构问题”的修辞略强于当前证据覆盖范围。

brief.summary: 论文研究长期记忆系统中的隐式关联盲区：当前请求可能必须受到某条个人事实约束，但两者只有借助世界知识才能建立联系，普通相似度检索因而看不到相关性。作者构建 InMind，通过直接召回、目标事实是否进入上下文以及最终应用三个指标，把存储、路由和推理失败分开测量。六种代表性记忆系统能够保存并直接召回事实，却在间接问题上全面失效，而同一骨干模型在事实直接可见时表现明显更好。更强嵌入只能带来有限改善，持续可见状态的诊断探针则恢复了大部分差距，说明值得研究的核心是记忆路由，而非继续单纯强化查询时搜索。论文对多轮助手和长时程规划很有启发，但“检索范式存在结构性缺陷”的外推仍需更丰富模型、真实交互和负例评测验证。

偏水风险：低
阅读来源：PDF 全文抽取
brief.motivation: 现有长期记忆评测多考察“用户明确询问时能否召回事实”，但直接召回成功并不代表系统会在真正需要时主动使用该事实。论文关注一种更隐蔽的失败：记忆与当前请求表面上不相似，二者只能通过模型掌握的世界知识建立联系；然而检索器在模型看到记忆之前就已完成相关性判断，可能让关键事实永远无法进入上下文。作者将其称为“隐式关联盲区”，并试图区分存储失败、模型缺少桥接知识和检索未呈现记忆这三类原因。
brief.method: 论文提出 InMind：包含 125 个任务、覆盖十类生活领域的长期记忆基准，其中 113 个任务以可引用公共资料为知识桥梁，另外 12 个由专家编写，全部经过专家核验。每个任务包含个人事实、直接召回问题和需要外部知识建立关联的间接问题；关键事实被插入 47 个会话组成的背景轨迹中，之后还经历 38 个会话的干扰。评测分别测量直接召回、间接查询上下文中是否出现目标事实，以及最终回答是否正确应用该事实，并用将目标记忆直接放入上下文的实验判断骨干模型是否具备桥接能力。作者还设计了一个始终可见、最多 200 行的用户状态文件作为诊断探针，用于检验绕开查询条件检索后能否恢复性能。
brief.experiments: 六种向量、图和 agentic memory 系统在直接问题上最高可完整召回目标事实，但在间接问题上的应用表现最高仅为 14.4%；包括朴素 RAG 在内的全部查询时配置最高为 16.0%。当关键记忆直接进入上下文时，同一 GPT-5-mini 骨干达到 84.0%，说明主要瓶颈发生在模型推理之前；间接查询下目标事实进入上下文的比例也普遍很低。将 384 维 MiniLM 换成 3072 维嵌入后，各系统的目标召回总体改善，但没有实质缩小与上下文上限的差距。始终可见的状态探针达到 68.8% 的间接应用和 98.4% 的直接召回，支持“关键在记忆路由和可见状态，而不只是存储或搜索强度”的判断。
brief.research_help: Insight：对 agent planning 和多轮智能体而言，记忆可靠性不能用直接召回率代替，因为规划约束可能通过药物、环境、规则或用户状态等世界知识间接影响后续决策。可迁移的设计方向是把长期记忆拆成可扩展的完整存储与受预算约束的持续可见状态，并将“哪些事实必须进入或留在工作状态”视为独立的路由问题。对 long-horizon reliability，评测应沿链路分别检查写入、保存、路由、上下文可见性和最终应用，避免把所有失败归因于推理模型。对 agentic RL，可把遗漏决策关键记忆、无依据过度提醒以及隐私暴露同时纳入训练信号，而不能只奖励成功检索或最终任务完成。

brief.abstract_zh: 长期记忆系统通常假定，需要使用的记忆会与当前查询具有足够相似性，但依赖世界知识才能建立联系的隐式关联会破坏这一假设。论文提出 InMind，一个包含 125 个专家核验任务、覆盖十个生活领域的基准，用配对控制区分事实未被存储、模型缺少桥接知识以及事实已存储但未被呈现三种失败。实验显示，骨干模型在关键记忆直接可见时能正确处理大部分间接查询，但六种记忆系统即使能在直接询问时召回同一事实，也极少能在间接查询中应用它。更高维嵌入虽改善目标记忆召回，却没有弥合主要差距，而一个让记忆在查询到来前持续可见的简单探针恢复了大部分性能，表明核心开放问题是决定哪些事实必须保持可见的记忆路由。

analysis.research_help: Insight：对 agent planning 和多轮智能体而言，记忆可靠性不能用直接召回率代替，因为规划约束可能通过药物、环境、规则或用户状态等世界知识间接影响后续决策。可迁移的设计方向是把长期记忆拆成可扩展的完整存储与受预算约束的持续可见状态，并将“哪些事实必须进入或留在工作状态”视为独立的路由问题。对 long-horizon reliability，评测应沿链路分别检查写入、保存、路由、上下文可见性和最终应用，避免把所有失败归因于推理模型。对 agentic RL，可把遗漏决策关键记忆、无依据过度提醒以及隐私暴露同时纳入训练信号，而不能只奖励成功检索或最终任务完成。

analysis.abstract_zh: 长期记忆系统通常假定，需要使用的记忆会与当前查询具有足够相似性，但依赖世界知识才能建立联系的隐式关联会破坏这一假设。论文提出 InMind，一个包含 125 个专家核验任务、覆盖十个生活领域的基准，用配对控制区分事实未被存储、模型缺少桥接知识以及事实已存储但未被呈现三种失败。实验显示，骨干模型在关键记忆直接可见时能正确处理大部分间接查询，但六种记忆系统即使能在直接询问时召回同一事实，也极少能在间接查询中应用它。更高维嵌入虽改善目标记忆召回，却没有弥合主要差距，而一个让记忆在查询到来前持续可见的简单探针恢复了大部分性能，表明核心开放问题是决定哪些事实必须保持可见的记忆路由。
analysis.card_summary: 这篇论文指出，智能体“记得某件事”不等于会在相关但表面不相似的请求中使用它。InMind 的实验显示，多种长期记忆系统在直接召回上表现很好，却普遍无法处理由世界知识连接的隐式关联，瓶颈主要落在关键记忆能否及时进入可见状态。
analysis.full_summary: 论文研究长期记忆系统中的隐式关联盲区：当前请求可能必须受到某条个人事实约束，但两者只有借助世界知识才能建立联系，普通相似度检索因而看不到相关性。作者构建 InMind，通过直接召回、目标事实是否进入上下文以及最终应用三个指标，把存储、路由和推理失败分开测量。六种代表性记忆系统能够保存并直接召回事实，却在间接问题上全面失效，而同一骨干模型在事实直接可见时表现明显更好。更强嵌入只能带来有限改善，持续可见状态的诊断探针则恢复了大部分差距，说明值得研究的核心是记忆路由，而非继续单纯强化查询时搜索。论文对多轮助手和长时程规划很有启发，但“检索范式存在结构性缺陷”的外推仍需更丰富模型、真实交互和负例评测验证。
analysis.value_label: 值得精读：记忆路由与规划可靠性
analysis.value_reason: 论文提出的问题清晰且重要，并用配对控制把“没存住、模型不会、没有送到模型面前”三个常被混淆的原因拆开，实验信号也具有较大且一致的差距。它对 agent memory、长期个性化、多轮决策和安全约束都有直接价值，不只是换模块后比较平均分。不过，其基准主动筛除了容易检索的样本，因此证明的是一个真实而关键的最坏区域，并不能据此断言检索式记忆在一般任务上整体无效；始终可见状态也只是诊断证据，不是已经解决规模、隐私和信息拥挤问题的系统方案。综合来看不像水文，概念、评测和诊断链条都较完整，但论文对“范式级结构问题”的修辞略强于当前证据覆盖范围。
analysis.limitations: 基准只有 125 个合成任务，并偏向健康、安全和规则明确的场景，尚不足以代表开放式规划、代码智能体或真实长期用户交互。任务通过低词法和低嵌入相似度筛选，能够精准暴露盲区，但也人为集中在相似度检索最不利的区域；缺少普通样本与负向控制，无法衡量改进路由后产生的过度提醒和误关联。实验主要依赖 GPT-5-mini，同时用其回答和判分，存在自偏好与单模型外推风险。始终可见探针与被比较系统在状态格式和更新器上均不同，不是严格受控消融，而且它面临上下文扩张、事实竞争和隐私暴露。部分系统出现最终应用率高于目标事实召回率，也提示指标或答案中先验知识可能产生偏差，需要更细致的人工误差分析。
source_evidence: 论文给出 125 个专家核验任务，其中 113 个具有可引用公共来源，另有 12 个专家编写任务。
关键事实被插入固定的 47 会话 LongMemEval-s 轨迹，并在接受查询前经历后续 38 个会话的干扰。
GPT-5-mini 在目标记忆直接可见时的间接应用率为 84.0%，而所有查询时检索配置最高为 16.0%。
六种记忆系统的直接召回最高为 100.0%，但其间接应用最高仅为 14.4%，支持失败主要不是事实未存储。依赖更高维嵌入后目标召回普遍上升，但整体差距仍然存在。始终可见状态探针取得 98.4% 的直接召回和 68.8% 的间接应用。

items.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
items.summary: Multi-turn long-horizon planning is critical for foundation model agents, yet how to fundamentally improve it remains unclear. Existing models are trained on uncontrollable and opaque Internet data, making it difficult to identify how planning ability is acquired, shaped, and integrated. To address this challenge, we introduce a unified and controlled multi-turn environment that enables precise control. It allows systematically study long-horizon planning across three stages. (1) Planning ability acquisition during pre-training. We study data format, distribution, and quality. Explicit world model construction through CoT state transition modeling yields stronger long-horizon generalization. Atomic skills alone are insufficient for compositional generalization, whereas a litte long-horizon data works. Moreover, suboptimal trajectories severely impair performance because errors amplify over long horizons. (2) Planning ability shaping via GRPO and OPD post-training. Through mutual information, we distinguish general planning patterns from task-specific planning knowledge. For planning patterns, we identify three application regions of post-training: unnecessary, effective, and unsupported. OPD has a broader effective region than GRPO under low-quality and long-horizon settings, as it provides more consistent update directions. For planning knowledge, distilling unseen procedures from a teacher with different knowledge may impair student's prior world modeling without fully establishing new knowledge. (3) Planning ability integration through MOPD post-training. We show that multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates capabilities by converging to shared planning-pattern across environments. Compatible patterns enable cross-environment generalization, partially shared patterns support continual learning, while completely conflicting patterns cause severe interference.

recommendation.label: 机制分析价值高，但外部有效性有限
recommendation.value_judgement: 值得读的主要原因不是提出了一个单点性能技巧，而是用统一框架串联了数据格式、轨迹长度、数据质量、GRPO、在策略蒸馏和多教师整合，并给出若干可被进一步验证的边界性结论。尤其是规划模式与规划知识的区分、长轨迹作为组合连接信号，以及教师冲突导致遗忘，均对 agentic RL 训练设计有直接启发。偏水风险不能评为低：环境、规则和任务均高度合成，模型由受控语料训练，缺少真实长程智能体基准上的验证；同时“Physics”式标题和统一理论叙事强于当前证据的普适范围。

brief.summary: 论文试图解释多轮长程规划能力从预训练到后训练究竟如何获得、塑形和整合。作者用分层技能图构建可控合成环境，从世界模型表达、训练轨迹长度、轨迹质量以及教师模式兼容性等维度做系统干预。主要实验显示，显式建模状态转移比直接预测动作具有更强的长程泛化，短任务中的原子技能不足以支持自动组合，而少量长轨迹即可提供明显帮助。对于通用规划模式，理想教师驱动的在策略蒸馏在困难条件下比 GRPO 更稳定，但对未见且不兼容的程序知识进行蒸馏可能损害学生已有能力。论文很适合用于形成 agent planning 的训练假设，不过其结论主要建立在合成技能图和受控模型上，尚不能直接视为真实网页、代码或具身智能体中的普遍规律。

brief.motivation: 现有基础模型的预训练数据不可控且不透明，因此很难判断长程规划能力究竟如何形成、后训练在什么条件下有效，以及多教师能力整合为何会产生迁移或遗忘。论文试图在统一可控的多轮环境中，把这一问题拆成预训练阶段的能力获取、GRPO/在策略蒸馏阶段的能力塑形，以及多教师蒸馏阶段的能力整合。
brief.method: 作者构建了三个合成领域的分层技能图环境，以 AND/OR 合成规则控制任务长度、规划知识、规划模式和轨迹质量，并用未见过的实体映射测试泛化。预训练实验比较直接动作预测与显式状态转移建模，也系统改变短、中、长轨迹的比例和最优/次优轨迹组成。后训练部分将任务相关的规划知识与可跨任务复用的规划模式区分开，比较 GRPO 和单教师在策略智能体蒸馏，并进一步用多教师在策略蒸馏研究跨环境迁移、持续学习和模式冲突。
brief.experiments: 实验给出了较清楚的受控因果信号：显式内化世界模型在中长程任务上的泛化明显优于直接动作预测；只学习原子技能几乎不能自动组合成长程能力，但加入少量较长轨迹后性能会显著跃升；混入次优决策会因误差逐步累积而使中长程成功率接近崩溃。论文还报告，在预训练质量较低、规划链较长时，理想教师提供密集方向的在策略蒸馏比依赖稀疏回报的 GRPO 适用范围更广。然而，教师与学生的程序知识不一致时，蒸馏新知识可能同时破坏旧世界模型；多教师方法也只有在模式兼容或部分共享时表现良好，完全冲突时仍会出现严重遗忘和跨环境干扰。
brief.research_help: Insight：长程可靠性不能仅靠扩大短任务或原子技能覆盖来获得，训练分布中必须存在能够示范跨步连接方式的长轨迹。对于 agentic RL，应先判断失败来自通用规划模式还是任务专属知识：前者适合使用理想教师的密集在策略监督，后者则可能需要更强的知识重建机制，而不是小幅策略更新。多环境能力整合的关键变量不是教师数量，而是教师之间是否存在共享的规划模式；训练前测量模式兼容性、隔离冲突知识并加入抗遗忘约束，可能比直接混合蒸馏更能提高持续学习和 long-horizon reliability。

brief.abstract_zh: 多轮长程规划是基础模型智能体的重要能力，但这种能力在不同训练阶段如何形成和改进仍不清楚。作者建立了一个可控制任务长度、数据质量、规划知识和规划模式的统一环境，分别研究预训练、GRPO/在策略蒸馏后训练以及多教师能力整合。实验表明，显式状态转移建模、少量长程轨迹和高质量决策数据对长程泛化至关重要；理想教师下的在策略蒸馏在低质量预训练和长规划链条件下比 GRPO 具有更广的有效区域。多教师蒸馏能够利用共享或部分共享的规划模式促进迁移和持续学习，但完全冲突的模式会造成灾难性遗忘与跨环境干扰。
brief.full_summary: 论文试图解释多轮长程规划能力从预训练到后训练究竟如何获得、塑形和整合。作者用分层技能图构建可控合成环境，从世界模型表达、训练轨迹长度、轨迹质量以及教师模式兼容性等维度做系统干预。主要实验显示，显式建模状态转移比直接预测动作具有更强的长程泛化，短任务中的原子技能不足以支持自动组合，而少量长轨迹即可提供明显帮助。对于通用规划模式，理想教师驱动的在策略蒸馏在困难条件下比 GRPO 更稳定，但对未见且不兼容的程序知识进行蒸馏可能损害学生已有能力。论文很适合用于形成 agent planning 的训练假设，不过其结论主要建立在合成技能图和受控模型上，尚不能直接视为真实网页、代码或具身智能体中的普遍规律。
brief.card_summary: 这篇论文用可控合成环境拆解多轮长程规划能力在预训练、强化学习后训练和多教师蒸馏中的形成规律。核心发现是：原子技能并不会自然组合成长程能力，轨迹质量和少量长程示范非常关键，而蒸馏是否有效取决于迁移的是通用规划模式还是不兼容的任务知识。

analysis.motivation: 现有基础模型的预训练数据不可控且不透明，因此很难判断长程规划能力究竟如何形成、后训练在什么条件下有效，以及多教师能力整合为何会产生迁移或遗忘。论文试图在统一可控的多轮环境中，把这一问题拆成预训练阶段的能力获取、GRPO/在策略蒸馏阶段的能力塑形，以及多教师蒸馏阶段的能力整合。
analysis.method: 作者构建了三个合成领域的分层技能图环境，以 AND/OR 合成规则控制任务长度、规划知识、规划模式和轨迹质量，并用未见过的实体映射测试泛化。预训练实验比较直接动作预测与显式状态转移建模，也系统改变短、中、长轨迹的比例和最优/次优轨迹组成。后训练部分将任务相关的规划知识与可跨任务复用的规划模式区分开，比较 GRPO 和单教师在策略智能体蒸馏，并进一步用多教师在策略蒸馏研究跨环境迁移、持续学习和模式冲突。
analysis.experiments: 实验给出了较清楚的受控因果信号：显式内化世界模型在中长程任务上的泛化明显优于直接动作预测；只学习原子技能几乎不能自动组合成长程能力，但加入少量较长轨迹后性能会显著跃升；混入次优决策会因误差逐步累积而使中长程成功率接近崩溃。论文还报告，在预训练质量较低、规划链较长时，理想教师提供密集方向的在策略蒸馏比依赖稀疏回报的 GRPO 适用范围更广。然而，教师与学生的程序知识不一致时，蒸馏新知识可能同时破坏旧世界模型；多教师方法也只有在模式兼容或部分共享时表现良好，完全冲突时仍会出现严重遗忘和跨环境干扰。
analysis.research_help: Insight：长程可靠性不能仅靠扩大短任务或原子技能覆盖来获得，训练分布中必须存在能够示范跨步连接方式的长轨迹。对于 agentic RL，应先判断失败来自通用规划模式还是任务专属知识：前者适合使用理想教师的密集在策略监督，后者则可能需要更强的知识重建机制，而不是小幅策略更新。多环境能力整合的关键变量不是教师数量，而是教师之间是否存在共享的规划模式；训练前测量模式兼容性、隔离冲突知识并加入抗遗忘约束，可能比直接混合蒸馏更能提高持续学习和 long-horizon reliability。

analysis.abstract_zh: 多轮长程规划是基础模型智能体的重要能力，但这种能力在不同训练阶段如何形成和改进仍不清楚。作者建立了一个可控制任务长度、数据质量、规划知识和规划模式的统一环境，分别研究预训练、GRPO/在策略蒸馏后训练以及多教师能力整合。实验表明，显式状态转移建模、少量长程轨迹和高质量决策数据对长程泛化至关重要；理想教师下的在策略蒸馏在低质量预训练和长规划链条件下比 GRPO 具有更广的有效区域。多教师蒸馏能够利用共享或部分共享的规划模式促进迁移和持续学习，但完全冲突的模式会造成灾难性遗忘与跨环境干扰。

analysis.value_label: 机制分析价值高，但外部有效性有限
analysis.value_reason: 值得读的主要原因不是提出了一个单点性能技巧，而是用统一框架串联了数据格式、轨迹长度、数据质量、GRPO、在策略蒸馏和多教师整合，并给出若干可被进一步验证的边界性结论。尤其是规划模式与规划知识的区分、长轨迹作为组合连接信号，以及教师冲突导致遗忘，均对 agentic RL 训练设计有直接启发。偏水风险不能评为低：环境、规则和任务均高度合成，模型由受控语料训练，缺少真实长程智能体基准上的验证；同时“Physics”式标题和统一理论叙事强于当前证据的普适范围。
analysis.limitations: 首先，实验主要依赖三个结构相似的合成物品合成环境，成功率反映的是封闭规则图上的规划，未覆盖真实工具错误、开放世界状态、不可逆操作和动态反馈。其次，受控随机初始化模型与专用语料有利于机制归因，却与已经吸收海量互联网知识的基础模型存在明显分布差异。再次，关于 GRPO 与在策略蒸馏适用区域的结论依赖理想教师，现实教师的系统性错误可能削弱甚至反转该优势。论文用互信息解释规划模式和规划知识很有启发，但从所提供文本看，这一区分更接近分析框架，尚不足以构成严格可测量的理论。最后，所提供的论文文本虽然标记为全文抽取，但在第五节中途结束，因此后续实验细节、消融和附录无法在当前材料中完整复核。
source_evidence: 预训练实验比较显式世界模型与直接动作预测，并报告前者在短、中、长难度上的泛化优势随规划长度增加而更加明显。
仅使用短任务训练时，中长程泛化几乎消失；加入少量中程或长程轨迹后，相应难度上的成功率出现显著提升。
混合次优规划模式后，中长程表现接近崩溃，作者将其归因于顺序决策错误的累积和放大。
论文明确区分跨任务复用的规划模式与任务专属的规划知识，并指出 OPD 对前者更适用，而不兼容的新程序知识可能破坏学生已有世界模型。答案中的多教师迁移与冲突结论同时得到摘要和引言所述实验总结支持。

items.title: MemTX: Transactional Belief Commit for Stateful Agent Memory
items.summary: LLM agents increasingly coordinate through persistent shared memory: one agent's write becomes another agent's premise, and eventually a tool call with real side effects. Current agent memory systems treat every accepted write as immediately actionable truth, so a polluted tool result, a stale update, or a teammate's half-finished note can silently drive an irreversible action. We argue that a memory write is not a belief commit. We present MemTX, a transactional belief-commit protocol. Each record carries evidence, permissions, provenance, and validity. Writes are staged inside snapshot-isolated transactions and admitted by a validate-and-commit pipeline, irreversible tool calls are gated on in-flight belief state, and retracting a belief triggers typed cascading repair of its derived records and tool side effects. Two invariants, action-safety gating and cascade-repair completeness, are machine-checked by property-based testing and bounded exhaustive enumeration of 5.5 million protocol states, with zero violations. Across five backbones from three model families, MemTX leads all eight baselines with paired-McNemar significance on four backbones and statistically ties the best baseline on the fifth and strongest, while remaining the only method with zero downstream harm on every backbone. Backbone capability does not substitute for commit discipline.

recommendation.label: 值得精读，但需审慎看待实验外推
recommendation.value_judgement: 选题直接命中 agent memory 与 long-horizon reliability 的关键失效链，方法把提交、行动门控和撤回修复统一成可执行协议，并明确报告负面结果与适用边界，技术内容并不空泛。偏水风险仍为中等，因为核心优势建立在作者自建的一致性套件、规则评分器和模拟工具上，部分基线是自行复现或单功能增强，而且最强门控保证没有在主要 LLM 路径中得到完整验证。

brief.summary: 这篇论文关注持久记忆中的错误如何跨轮次、跨智能体传播，并最终污染不可逆工具调用。MemTX 将观察记录与可行动信念分离，通过事务、显式生命周期、权限继承、语义冲突裁决和依赖图管理记忆状态。信念被撤回后，系统会沿派生关系修复摘要、共享副本及工具副作用，从而把可靠性边界从写入时延伸到行动时和事后恢复。作者在自建主测试、复合腐化测试和有界状态枚举中给出了较一致的正面结果，其中零下游伤害尤其值得关注。与此同时，LLM 实验没有完整覆盖强行动门控，基准也缺少真实部署与独立复现，因此结果更适合被视为有力的协议设计证据，而非生产可靠性的最终证明。对研究 agent memory、长时程规划和多智能体状态一致性的人而言，这篇论文值得精读。

阅读来源：PDF 全文抽取
brief.motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统往往把“写入一条观察”直接等同于“确认一项可据此行动的信念”，使污染的工具结果、过期更新、未完成的共享笔记或越权转述可能一路传播到退款、邮件等不可逆操作。论文认为，记忆正确性不能止于写入和冲突消解，还必须覆盖行动时的成熟度检查，以及信念撤回后的派生状态修复。
brief.method: MemTX 将数据库事务思想引入有状态智能体记忆，为记录维护证据、权限、来源、有效期、置信度和派生依赖图，并设置从 tentative、validated、committed 到 action-safe 等显式状态。写入在快照隔离事务中暂存，再依次经过证据、时效、语义冲突和依赖稳定性检查；不可逆工具调用受到行动门控。信念撤回后，系统沿派生图执行类型化级联修复：撤销派生信念、隔离摘要与共享副本，并补偿或登记已泄漏的工具副作用。
brief.experiments: 作者构建了包含90个主测试案例和56个复合腐化案例的专用一致性测试集，覆盖工具结果污染、迟到写入、脏读、语义冲突、权限洗白和级联回滚失败，并在五个模型骨干上比较八个基线。MemTX 在四个骨干的主测试上领先，在最强骨干上与最佳增强基线统计持平；在复合测试上重新拉开差距，并且是所有骨干上唯一保持下游伤害为零的方法。消融结果支持语义冲突裁决、权限继承、级联回滚、行动门控、可见性范围和快照读取分别负责不同故障族。不过这些结果主要来自作者自建、规则评分的模拟工具环境，LLM 主实验只实际检验了较弱的行动门控形式，因而尚不能直接证明真实生产系统中的可靠性。
brief.research_help: Insight：对 long-horizon agent 来说，记忆不应只是可检索文本，而应成为带成熟度、权限、时效和因果依赖的受治理状态；规划器只有在相关信念完成提交后才能执行不可逆动作。多轮系统中的回滚也不能只删除原始事实，而要沿派生链修复摘要、画像、共享副本和工具动作，否则旧错误会持续影响后续计划。论文还揭示了一个更关键的开放问题：仅靠显式 provenance 无法阻止模型在转述时省略来源，因此可靠规划需要让来源约束随内容传播到行动边界，而不是依赖智能体自觉声明。

brief.abstract_zh: 持久共享记忆让一个智能体的写入成为其他智能体决策和工具调用的依据，但现有系统常把被接受的写入立即视为可行动的事实。MemTX 提出事务化信念提交协议，使记录携带证据、权限、来源和有效性，并在快照隔离事务中经过验证后提交。系统还会根据进行中的信念状态限制不可逆工具调用，并在信念撤回时对派生记录和工具副作用执行类型化级联修复。作者通过性质测试和约550万种协议状态的有界枚举验证关键不变量，并报告在五个模型骨干上总体优于八个基线且保持零下游伤害。

brief.card_summary: MemTX 把智能体记忆写入改造成带暂存、验证、提交、行动门控和级联回滚的事务协议，目标是阻止错误或越权记忆触发不可逆操作。实验信号较强且问题高度相关，但证据主要来自作者自建模拟基准，真实环境效果仍待独立验证。

analysis.motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统往往把“写入一条观察”直接等同于“确认一项可据此行动的信念”，使污染的工具结果、过期更新、未完成的共享笔记或越权转述可能一路传播到退款、邮件等不可逆操作。论文认为，记忆正确性不能止于写入和冲突消解，还必须覆盖行动时的成熟度检查，以及信念撤回后的派生状态修复。
analysis.method: MemTX 将数据库事务思想引入有状态智能体记忆，为记录维护证据、权限、来源、有效期、置信度和派生依赖图，并设置从 tentative、validated、committed 到 action-safe 等显式状态。写入在快照隔离事务中暂存，再依次经过证据、时效、语义冲突和依赖稳定性检查；不可逆工具调用受到行动门控。信念撤回后，系统沿派生图执行类型化级联修复：撤销派生信念、隔离摘要与共享副本，并补偿或登记已泄漏的工具副作用。
analysis.experiments: 作者构建了包含90个主测试案例和56个复合腐化案例的专用一致性测试集，覆盖工具结果污染、迟到写入、脏读、语义冲突、权限洗白和级联回滚失败，并在五个模型骨干上比较八个基线。MemTX 在四个骨干的主测试上领先，在最强骨干上与最佳增强基线统计持平；在复合测试上重新拉开差距，并且是所有骨干上唯一保持下游伤害为零的方法。消融结果支持语义冲突裁决、权限继承、级联回滚、行动门控、可见性范围和快照读取分别负责不同故障族。不过这些结果主要来自作者自建、规则评分的模拟工具环境，LLM 主实验只实际检验了较弱的行动门控形式，因而尚不能直接证明真实生产系统中的可靠性。
analysis.research_help: Insight：对 long-horizon agent 来说，记忆不应只是可检索文本，而应成为带成熟度、权限、时效和因果依赖的受治理状态；规划器只有在相关信念完成提交后才能执行不可逆动作。多轮系统中的回滚也不能只删除原始事实，而要沿派生链修复摘要、画像、共享副本和工具动作，否则旧错误会持续影响后续计划。论文还揭示了一个更关键的开放问题：仅靠显式 provenance 无法阻止模型在转述时省略来源，因此可靠规划需要让来源约束随内容传播到行动边界，而不是依赖智能体自觉声明。

analysis.limitations: 第一，测试集、运行器和评分规则均由作者构建，案例可能天然贴合 MemTX 的设计分解，尚缺公开真实工作流和第三方基准验证。第二，主要 LLM 实验只使用低风险和中风险事务，强行动门控主要由脚本实验及附录配置检验。第三，强门控只要求快照中存在至少一个 action-safe 信念，并不保证该信念与当前动作输入存在因果对应。第四，级联修复依赖显式记录的 provenance，智能体若在转述时省略父记录，权限和撤回约束就可能失效；论文报告该来源范围故障在所有方法和骨干上均未解决。第五，补偿仅是决策层日志义务，并非真实环境回放，已经发生的不可逆副作用只能标记为泄漏。第六，论文仍是预印本且处于评审中，文中基线实现、统计结论和零伤害结果尚待独立复现。
source_evidence: 论文明确区分记录观察与提交可行动信念，并给出八状态生命周期、五种读取隔离级别和四类风险事务。
机器验证覆盖约553万种规范状态及约1054万次状态转移，作者报告关键不变量零违规，但这是有界运行时验证，不是无界形式化证明。

56例复合腐化测试中，MemTX 在四个较强骨干上取得更明显优势；能力较弱的Qwen2.5-14B整体表现显著下降。文章同时报告24例下游流程中MemTX在所有骨干上零伤害。以上均为作者自建规则评分环境中的结果。LLM主路径未启用强行动门控，只验证了较弱形式。来源转述不声明父记录与跨事务重试是作者明确承认的未解决盲点。

items.title: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Large language models are increasingly trained as interactive agents for long-horizon tasks involving multi-turn interaction, tool use, and environment feedback. Outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) provides a practical optimization paradigm, but its sparse trajectory-level rewards offer limited guidance on intermediate decisions, leaving a supervision gap between episode-level outcomes and token-level policy learning. We propose SEED (SElf-Evolving On-Policy Distillation), a self-evolving framework that converts completed on-policy trajectories into training-time hindsight skills and distills their behavioral effect back into the policy model. SEED first fine-tunes the policy to analyze completed trajectories and generate natural-language skills that capture reusable workflows, decisive observations, or failure-avoidance rules. During RL, the current policy both collects trajectories and serves as the analyzer that extracts hindsight skills from them. Policy updates therefore improve subsequent decision making and skill analysis together, allowing hindsight supervision to evolve with the policy. SEED then re-scores the sampled actions under ordinary and skill-augmented contexts, converting the skill-induced probability shift into a dense token-level on-policy distillation signal. This signal is jointly optimized with outcome-based RL, keeping the auxiliary supervision aligned with the current trajectory distribution. Extensive experiments on text-based and vision-based agentic tasks show that SEED consistently improves performance and sample efficiency, exhibiting robust generalization to unseen scenarios. Our code is available at this https URL.

items.title: Branching Policy Optimization: Sandbox-Native Language Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Reinforcement learning has emerged as the dominant paradigm for training large language model (LLM) agents that interact with executable sandboxes. State-of-the-art algorithms such as PPO, RLOO, and GRPO inherit their rollout topology from RLHF: for each prompt, N independent trajectories are sampled from the initial state, and an advantage is computed by subtracting a group baseline. This design ignores a defining property of agent sandboxes. They are deterministic, snapshottable, and resumable from any intermediate state. We argue that this property enables a fundamentally different rollout topology: rather than N independent trees of depth T, one can construct a single tree of N leaves whose siblings share prefixes, and therefore share variance. We instantiate this idea as Branching Policy Optimization (BPO), a sandbox-native RL algorithm that (i) adaptively snapshots the sandbox at high-entropy decision points along a backbone trajectory, (ii) forks K alternative actions per branch point and rolls out each to termination, and (iii) computes per-step advantages from sibling returns rather than from independent prompts. We prove this estimator is unbiased and has strictly lower variance than the trajectory-level baseline, with the reduction equal to the prefix-explained portion of return variance. On WebShop, ALFWorld, and SWE-bench Verified with Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.1-8B backbones, BPO improves success by 3.6--6.1 absolute points over GRPO and RLOO at matched compute, halves gradient-norm variance, and matches the best baseline using 38% fewer policy updates.

items.title: ToolAnchor: Anchoring Counterfactual Context to Boost Agentic Tool-use Capability
items.summary: Tool-augmented large language model agents excel at long-horizon tasks, yet they are typically post-trained on fixed toolsets. When tasks demand new tools, these agents struggle to incorporate them effectively, and retraining from scratch is often impractical. We identify the core obstacle in such toolset expansion problem as behavioral inertia: the tendency of agents to fall back on familiar tools and established reasoning patterns despite having access to new ones. We demonstrate that injecting counterfactual anchor contexts at critical decision points can break this inertia, recovering failed trajectories by eliciting suppressed agent capabilities. To scale this insight, we propose ToolAnchor, a framework that uses teacher models to hypothesize these counterfactual contexts, verifies them via student rollouts, and internalizes the successful interventions through agentic post-training. Extensive evaluations across general AI assistant (GAIA), textual search (BrowseComp), and visual search (VDR-Bench) tasks demonstrate that ToolAnchor consistently exhibits competitive performance under expanded toolsets. Our work bridges the gap between static post-training and dynamic adaptation, charting a new path for scalable agentic reinforcement learning.

items.title: PRO-LONG: Programmatic Memory Enables Long-Horizon Reasoning
items.summary: Long-horizon tasks require sustained perception, reasoning, and exploration, and are a persistent challenge for large language model (LLM) agents. This gap is reflected in their limited performance on continual learning benchmarks such as ARC-AGI-3, especially when models are evaluated out of the box. Various agent harnesses have been proposed to close this gap, and each commits to a strategy for handling long sequences of observations, i.e., what information to save from the environment and how to load it into model context, a choice we argue is particularly consequential. Existing methods for context management face a significant tradeoff, as preserving more information makes retrieving relevant details less tractable. We propose PRO-LONG, a minimal context management framework built around programmatic memory for LLM agents in long-horizon, exploratory settings. PRO-LONG addresses the tradeoff by keeping a complete, structured interaction log and capitalizing on recent progress in coding agents to search this history efficiently. On the full ARC-AGI-3 public game set, PRO-LONG improves over a base coding agent by an average of 18.0 percentage points across frontier models, and matches or exceeds state-of-the-art specialized harnesses (up to 76.1% pass@1) while using 4.2-5.8x fewer tokens. With Fable 5, PRO-LONG achieves 97.4% best@2 at a total cost of \$1,750. Relevant code and logs are available at this https URL.

items.title: AppWorld-UL: Benchmarking Diverse Agent-User Interactions for Tool-Use
items.summary: Tool-use agents that address day-to-day digital tasks such as ordering groceries must not only operate applications, but also interact with the user, e.g., to ask clarification questions, prompt for confirmation, and inform the user when the instruction is infeasible. However, current benchmarks for evaluating agent-user interactions do not capture the diversity of such interactions. Further, they operate in small environments with few, often non-state-changing, APIs. To address this gap, we introduce AppWorld-UL, a ``user-in-the-loop'' benchmark of 516 challenging tasks requiring diverse agent-user interactions. Building upon the AppWorld framework with 9 popular simulated apps like Amazon and Spotify, we systematically modify original tasks to introduce ambiguities and constraints that necessitate various types of agent-user interaction. User behavior is simulated by an LLM prompted to respond with carefully designed knowledge boundaries, offering more reliable simulation than the unconstrained or overly rigid alternatives used in prior work. Our evaluation reveals that a state-of-the-art LLM, Claude Opus 4.7, achieves only 48.6% success on AppWorld-UL, and only 35.7% on the harder, compositional subset. On the stricter, scenario-level metric, compositional task performance drops to only 21.3%. Our analysis reveals that correct user-interaction is crucial for success. This demonstrates the benchmark's difficulty and its potential to advance research on user-in-the-loop tool-use agents.

items.title: One More Turn, Less Regret: A Regret-Based Multi-Turn Benchmark for LLMs' Clarification Policies
items.summary: Ambiguous user requests make clarification a sequential decision problem for conversational LLM assistants: they must decide whether to ask, what to ask, when to stop, and when to answer. We introduce RegretBench, a multi-turn benchmark that evaluates clarification as policy behavior rather than isolated question quality. RegretBench provides a hidden-intent formulation of ambiguity, supports free-form interaction grounded in semantic-state tracking, and introduces a regret-based objective that measures how much value a model loses relative to a reference clarification policy. Experiments on open-domain QA and product recommendation scenarios show that final success alone is insufficient, as models with similar accuracy can differ substantially in efficiency, robustness to user behaviors, and stopping decisions. By jointly measuring intent resolution, interaction cost, ineffective clarification, and regret, RegretBench reveals whether models clarify usefully and efficiently. Our results show that effective clarification requires more than plausible questions: models must ask the right question at the right time and stop once the user's intended meaning is clear.

items.title: ICAE-Bench: Evaluating Coding Agents as Interactive Project Builders
items.summary: The recent emergence of vibe-coding workflows is changing what coding agents are expected to do. Instead of merely completing code under fully specified instructions, agents are increasingly expected to transform incomplete product intent into working software by combining various abilities including planning, requirement clarification, tool use, debugging, and repository-level construction. Yet existing benchmarks have not fully caught up with this shift, evaluating agents on static, fully specified tasks. In this paper, we introduce ICAE-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents under interactive project-building settings. The basic idea is to start from a fuzzy product requirement, simulating the dynamic paradigm with an automated User Agent. To make this setting both realistic and evaluable, ICAE-Bench introduces three key designs. First, to avoid the ambiguity of unconstrained fuzzy requirements, each task derives ambiguity from a precise real open-source repository with executable behavior. Second, to ensure high-quality and reproducible user simulation, ICAE-Bench grounds interaction through User Agent Data, allowing the User Agent to reveal hidden constraints without inventing new requirements or leaking implementation artifacts. Third, to evaluate open-ended repositories fairly, ICAE-Bench uses standardized black-box tests together with multi-dimensional diagnostics, including functional correctness, semantic and API similarity, structural fidelity, design quality, and interaction quality.

items.title: DynamicMCPBench: A Trace-Grounded, Effect-Scored Benchmark for LLM Agents over Live MCP Servers
items.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed over Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, yet the benchmarks used to evaluate them score the final answer or a fixed "ground-truth" list of tools, both of which are fragile once the underlying data is live and stateful. We present DynamicMCPBench, a reusable framework rather than a fixed dataset. A practitioner can run it on their own MCP servers to test models on their own tasks, or let it collect servers automatically to measure a model's general ability to solve agentic tasks. Given the servers and any set of models, it generates realistic goals, pursues each one live to record a successful trajectory, distills that trajectory into path-agnostic effect checkpoints, and scores an agent on whether it reproduces those effects, never on the final answer. To show what the framework reveals, we run it at scale: 24 models over 121 servers and 750 tasks spread evenly over 15 task categories (50 each), where each category targets a distinct tool-use challenge of the generated questions. Each task is scored by pass^3: it counts as solved only if all three independent attempts succeed. Even the strongest agents solve only about half of the tasks, 31% of tasks are solved by no model at all, and accuracy collapses as the required tool chain grows longer (from 39% on the shortest chains to 13% on the longest). A human validation study confirms the automatic scoring is reliable (chance-corrected agreement of 0.76). DynamicMCPBench thus turns benchmark construction into something practitioners can rerun on their own servers and models, while exposing a consistent inability of current agents to handle long, multi-step agentic tasks.

items.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
items.summary: Modern AI agents rely on elaborate inference harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw to drive multi-turn reasoning, tool use, and access to external systems. While powerful, these complex harnesses also make agents hard to train end-to-end with open infrastructure, whose SFT/RL stacks cannot natively express stateful, multi-process harness inference. To address this, we present OpenForgeRL, an open-source framework for training harness-based agents end-to-end in diverse environments. OpenForgeRL achieves this with a lightweight proxy that serves the harness's model calls while recording them as training data for a standard RL codebase (e.g., veRL), and a Kubernetes orchestrator that runs each rollout in its own remote container, together enabling training on any harness in any environment at scale. By decoupling training and inference, OpenForgeRL allows researchers to easily train, study, and improve agents directly in the real harnesses and environments they are deployed with. We validate our framework across diverse, complex harnesses and environments, spanning tool/claw-based agents and multimodal GUI browser- and computer-use agents. Using only hundreds to a few thousand tasks, OpenForgeClaw reaches 31.7 pass^3 and 55.9 pass@3 on ClawEval and 33.7 on QwenClawBench. OpenForgeGUI reaches 37.7 on OSWorld-Verified, 63.0 on Online-Mind2Web, and 72.3 on WebVoyager. Both outperform open baselines of similar size on nearly all benchmarks, and in the GUI setting match or surpass models several times larger. Beyond benchmarks, we analyze how harness choice (e.g., ZeroClaw, OpenClaw, Codex) and RL shape agent behavior. We find that some harnesses are substantially harder to learn than others, and that RL improves agentic reliability, such as self-verification, tool coverage, and completing multi-step plans, though critical abilities such as error recovery remain weak.

items.title: Workflow-Localized Mechanism Learning: Attribution-Guided Repair and Knowledge Reuse for Structured Agent Skills
items.summary: Agent Skills package reusable procedural knowledge as external artifacts for frozen language-model agents, yet existing optimizers do not jointly resolve where a failure occurs in a workflow, which mechanism caused it, and how relevant knowledge from third-party Skills should be reused locally. We introduce Workflow-Localized Mechanism Learning (WML). Its Node--Mechanism Attribution identifies the failed workflow node, implicated mechanisms, and smallest valid edit target, routing single-mechanism defects to L3 resources and relational defects across mechanisms to L2 composition protocols. A six-module Workflow-Guided Skill Optimization (WGSO) loop then selects provenance- and scope-aware third-party knowledge, applies bounded patches, evaluates candidates, and stores verified outcomes in optimizer-side memory. On SpreadsheetBench, WML reaches 90.33 +/- 1.53 and 74.67 +/- 3.51 Hard Accuracy with DeepSeek and Qwen3.6-Flash, respectively; without additional optimization, the learned Skills transfer to WikiTableQuestions with 84.00 +/- 2.00 and 83.00 +/- 2.00 Denotation Accuracy. On Compiler-Supported50, WML attains both the highest hard-PASS rate and the lowest cost per successful task; compiled execution sharply reduces tokens and calls relative to a direct SkillAgent while retaining most of its successful tasks. Code and artifacts are available at this https URL.

items.title: GuardianAgentBench: Where Agents Fail and How to Guard Them
items.summary: As large language model agents increasingly operate autonomously with access to tools and external environments, ensuring their safe and reliable behavior becomes critical. We present GuardianAgentBench (GABench), a benchmark of 580 scenarios across six domains evaluated on three production-ready frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Vectara. The benchmark incorporates rigorous multi-stage validation and five adversarial attack modes. Experiments with six state-of-the-art models reveal that even the strongest configuration achieves only 74.8% overall accuracy and expose two distinct failure regimes: stronger models under-call required tools, while weaker models mis-select and over-call tools. Performance degrades monotonically with both tool-set size and sequential turn depth, with long-horizon planning proving the steeper bottleneck. Our guardrail implementation consistently outperforms system-prompt-based defenses across all models, recovering 19.9% of failures at a false positive rate of just 0.5%. These results demonstrate that execution-time structural intervention improves safety without disrupting correct agent behavior.

items.title: PersonaTrail: Benchmarking Personalized Web Agents through Browsing Trails
items.summary: Recent advances in large language models have enabled web agents to autonomously execute complex tasks. In practice, users frequently provide underspecified instructions, requiring agents to infer the missing context from their raw browsing histories. Existing benchmarks fail to capture this form of personalization, as they either restrict tasks to fully explicit prompts or abstract web interaction history into simplified forms. To bridge this gap, we introduce PersonaTrail, a benchmark for personalized web agents operating in a managed open web environment. By leveraging realistic browsing trajectories as user history, PersonaTrail evaluates an agent's ability to infer user preferences and recall information from past browsing sessions. We further propose Preference-Aware Contextual Memory (PACMem), a framework that decomposes raw browsing histories into two types of structured memory: factual memories that summarize individual sessions and preference memories that distill recurring behavioral patterns. At inference time, the agent retrieves the most relevant entries from these memories to guide personalized navigation. Extensive experiments show that PACMem consistently outperforms existing memory-based baselines on both tasks.

items.title: The Regression Tax: Decomposing Why Skills Help and Hurt LLM Agents
items.summary: Adding procedural skills to an LLM agent is typically evaluated by average improvement in task success. However, this metric hides an important cost: skills can also make agents worse. We measure both sides by comparing agents with and without skills across nearly 6,000 runs spanning two office automation benchmarks and three model harness stacks. This allows us to distinguish two outcomes. A regression is a task solved without skills but failed after skills are added. A residual failure is a task that fails both with and without skills. We find that regressions are substantial enough that the best performing skills outperform others primarily by regressing less, not by gaining more. We identify three causes of regression: (i) skill description osmosis, a skill changes an agent's behavior simply by being present in context, even when it is never invoked; (ii) grounding displacement, a skill's prescribed procedure overrides how the agent interprets its inputs; and (iii) verification displacement, where the procedure suppresses checks the agent would otherwise perform on its outputs. Analysing persistent failures reveals the same underlying pattern. Existing skills overemphasize procedural guidance the stage least often responsible for failure while under supporting grounding and verification, the dominant sources of remaining errors. After correcting evaluation artifacts and studying traces, we find many regressions and persistent failures recoverable through better grounding and verification. Procedural skills should be evaluated by decomposing their net effect into gains and regressions, not by aggregate improvement alone. We identify three regression modes skills should avoid, and find that reliability depends more on grounding and verification than on procedural skill choice.

items.title: TRACE-ROUTER: Task-Consistent and Adaptive Online Routing for Agentic AI
items.summary: Routing to select large language models (LLMs) with different cost-quality trade-offs has become a fundamental deployment feature of enterprise AI. Existing routers, primarily make independent routing decisions for each LLM call. However, agentic applications execute as long-horizon workflows whose quality is determined only by a delayed, task-level outcome. This mismatch prevents per-call routers from correctly attributing feedback to individual routing decisions. Towards mitigating this, we present TRACE-Router, a task-level routing framework that aligns routing with the unit of supervision. TRACE-Router assigns each task to a model once at admission using a contextual bandit, pins all subsequent LLM calls to the selected backend, and updates its policy using the task's terminal reward, jointly accounting for accuracy and latency. By leveraging delayed task feedback, TRACE-Router learns routing policies that adapt to the workload while avoiding explicit task-complexity estimation. Across three agentic benchmarks, TRACE-Router consistently improves the accuracy-latency trade-off, achieving non-dominated Pareto frontier points. On tau2-Bench, it outperforms latency-matched interpolation between individual models by 7-8 accuracy points, while on Terminal-Bench it achieves 7.1 higher accuracy points than the strongest single model baseline with 36% lower latency.

items.title: DBA-Bench: A Production-Fidelity Benchmark for LLM-Based Database Operations Agents
items.summary: LLM-based database agents show promise, but differing task scopes, testbeds, and metrics hinder comparison. We identify four gaps between evaluation and production operations: live-environment fidelity (multi-turn read-write interaction with a running database); observation-space scale and complexity (causal diagnosis across thousands of time series, business logs, and concurrent activity); solution-space openness (multiple remediations with different operational trade-offs); and scenario complexity and coverage (faults cascading across internal mechanisms and operational domains). We present DBA-Bench, a benchmark addressing these gaps through production fidelity, outcome-first evaluation, and controlled scenario reproducibility. It uses instrumented PostgreSQL environments with active workloads, persistent state, and multi-source observations; defines success by measurable recovery or fault elimination under safety constraints; and restores snapshots with scenario-specific checks before each run. The benchmark contains 106 scenarios across seven task domains, with two public difficulty labels based on reference-path diagnostic depth and environmental complexity. We evaluate nine baseline groups, including six foundation-model systems, two GPT-5.5-backed database agents, and a Human DBA reference. Across 848 automated runs, Diagnosis, Outcome, and Safe Pass rates are 32.7%, 19.6%, and 12.4%; the best automated baseline reaches 17.9% Safe Pass versus 93.4% for the Human DBA reference. Automated Safe Pass falls from 19.6% on Easy scenarios to 7.6% on Hard scenarios, underscoring the difficulty of safe end-to-end remediation.

items.title: SceneActBench: Can Agents Act on the 3D Scenes They See?
items.summary: Vision-language model (VLM) agents increasingly use tools to act on 3D scenes rather than only describe them. Existing 3D benchmarks score textual responses or single-object operations, leaving agent action on complete multi-object 3D scenes under evaluated. We present SceneActBench, a benchmark for visually conditioned action across five 3D tasks under a unified agent-environment loop. Given PNG images or sampled video frames and, where applicable, supplied 3D assets, an agent acts on a 3D environment. We evaluate each final output against hidden ground truth with task-specific geometric metrics. SceneActBench comprises five tasks built from 210 source instances, yielding 520 task cases including paired input conditions. Every task runs through one fixed agent loop to keep the comparison fair. Across eleven proprietary VLM configurations, Overall scores span 38.6-50.2, and none performs consistently well across tasks. We further analyse where and how failures manifest.

items.title: FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills
items.summary: Large language model agents increasingly solve complex tasks by constructing inference-time workflows that combine reasoning, tool use, and code execution. While such workflows enable flexible problem solving, the useful procedures discovered during execution are often transient: they help solve the current task but are not retained in a form that can systematically benefit future tasks. We present FlowEvo, a training-free framework that compiles successful traces into reusable skill records. Each record pairs a callable artifact with auxiliary structured guidance, and admission applies interface, replay, and safety checks where feasible. These skill records persist in a skill bank at inference time. FlowEvo is organized around three coupled mechanisms: (1)~workflow-to-skill compilation, which extracts reusable executable artifacts from successful traces; (2)~skill-to-workflow feedback, which retrieves accumulated skills to support future problem solving through either direct execution or structured context injection; and (3)~skill curation, which monitors downstream utility and suppresses skills that cause negative transfer. Through this workflow--skill--workflow feedback loop, FlowEvo enables agents to accumulate and refine task-solving capability over time without updating model parameters. Experiments on benchmarks spanning interactive environments (ALFWorld) and code/math generation (HumanEval, GSM8K) show that FlowEvo achieves the best accuracy-cost tradeoff among the evaluated baselines under our implementation settings. On ALFWorld, FlowEvo achieves an 82.8\% success rate, 23.6 percentage points above the strongest baseline, while its average token usage per episode is less than half that of the most efficient baseline. Controlled ablations confirm that each mechanism contributes to the overall result. The code is public at this https URL.

items.title: Ground Truth First: A Longitudinal Evaluation Instrument for Agent Memory, and the Tenure Crossover in Memory-Architecture Rankings
items.summary: Benchmarks for LLM-agent memory typically generate conversations first and extract answer keys afterwards -- with documented label-error and contamination problems -- and they overwhelmingly measure short interaction histories. We invert the pipeline: a seeded life-script sampler emits facts with validity intervals, volatility classes, and source channels before any text exists; an LLM renderer writes chat and email from per-event fact manifests; a fidelity verifier confirms every planted fact; and questions are instantiated mechanically from the script, so gold answers are script-valid by construction and separately validated for answerability. The synthetic, fictionalized corpus (~380 questions, 15 types) embeds features absent from the benchmarks we survey: per-fact validity intervals, sent/received trust distinctions, injection probes in a benign harness, and as-of-date question sets. Benchmarking five memory architectures against a no-memory control (fixed answerer, versioned LLM judge, three replicates, two horizons), we find backend rankings invert with history length: the budgeted curated-map memory that leads at three weeks loses recall of evicted content by nine weeks (96% to 72%) while a provenance-typed graph rises to 90%; the inversion is positive for all six users under complete cross-family re-judging (exact p=0.031). A full-rendered-history baseline ties or exceeds the best memory system at the short horizon but shows no judge-independent advantage at nine weeks, at about twice the read cost. Write-stage quality strongly correlates with downstream quality (weakly-written facts fail 24% vs 2%), and injection resistance tracked whether provenance boundaries survive representation. A layered architecture performs best among the memory systems in both regimes (96.8% short-horizon) and is released as Veracium, an open-source library, with the corpus generator and harness.

items.title: TRACE: Turn-level Reward Assignment via Credit Estimation for Long-Horizon Agents
items.summary: Multi-turn agents solve complex tasks through extended sequences of tool interactions before producing a final answer, making credit assignment a fundamental challenge during post-training. Outcome rewards provide reliable supervision for short-horizon reasoning, but become sparse and high-variance as trajectories grow to tens or hundreds of tool calls. They can also be misleading: a failed rollout may contain many useful actions that move the agent closer to the goal, yet outcome-only training assigns them the same negative advantage as the eventual mistake. We propose TRACE (Turn-level Reward Assignment via Credit Estimation), a dense credit-assignment method for agentic reinforcement learning. TRACE represents rollouts as state transitions at tool-call boundaries, obtains gold-answer log-probabilities from a frozen reference model, transforms them into log-ratio state values, and derives per-action rewards as Temporal-Difference changes in those values. This requires no additional critic or process-label training, and its one-step log-ratio TD component telescopes across redundant tool calls. On long-horizon complex search, TRACE substantially improves base-model tool-use ability using pure RL, without a cold-start supervised fine-tuning stage, an agentic mid-training stage, or training on live-web data. On the closed-web BrowseComp-Plus benchmark, it raises Qwen3-4B from $7.2$ to $35.6$ and Qwen3-30B-A3B from $8.4$ to $42.6$. The learned search behavior also transfers to open-web benchmarks, and the learning curves show earlier improvement and faster convergence during RL training.

brief.summary: 本文提出 TRACE，解决长程工具智能体只依赖最终成败奖励时，难以判断每一步检索、打开和定位操作是否真正有价值的问题。其核心是冻结一个参考模型，用轨迹各前缀条件下正确答案的可生成性估计局部状态价值，并以相邻价值的对数比变化为工具调用分配信用。方法同时保留 GRPO 的终局可验证奖励，因而局部“更像答案”的信号不会单独决定训练目标；有限 K-step 回传则把后续证据的收益适度传给早期检索动作。受控比较显示，它在闭卷长程搜索、开放网页检索和中文深搜基准上普遍优于 GRPO、GSPO 与 GiGRPO，并呈现更早的学习提升。阅读价值在于它给出了一种无需过程标注或训练 critic 的可操作长程 credit-assignment 配方，但当前证据主要覆盖短、可验证答案的搜索任务，对代码修复、开放式规划等长结构输出的可靠性仍未充分验证。

偏水风险：中
阅读来源：PDF 全文抽取
brief.motivation: 长轨迹工具调用的终局奖励既稀疏又高方差：失败轨迹中可能包含有效检索，成功轨迹中也可能夹杂冗余操作，导致 outcome-only RL 无法准确区分每一步对最终答案的贡献。TRACE旨在在不引入过程标注、强评审模型或额外 critic 的前提下，为工具调用级决策提供更密的、仍受最终可验证答案约束的训练信号。
brief.method: 将每条轨迹按工具调用边界切分为前缀状态；冻结的参考模型计算给定前缀时生成 gold answer 的平均对数概率，并将其转为相对初始“答案不确定性缺口”的对数比状态值。相邻状态值之差构成一步 TD credit，正值表示该工具动作及其观测使正确答案更可预测；再用有限窗口的 K-step 回传处理延迟生效的检索动作，并与 GRPO 的终局 outcome advantage 混合优化。该设计的单步项具有望远镜求和性质，理论上不会因插入冗余中间调用而累计获得额外总信用。
brief.experiments: 在基于 OpenResearcher 离线语料构造的长链检索训练环境中，作者以 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 为骨干，最多允许 60 次工具调用，并与同条件的 GRPO、GSPO、GiGRPO 比较。闭卷网页 BrowseComp-Plus 上，TRACE 将 4B 从基础模型的 7.2 提升至 35.6，将 30B-A3B 从 8.4 提升至 42.6；相对 GRPO，四基准平均值分别由 29.5 提升至 34.0、由 32.5 提升至 38.1。开放网页 BrowseComp、GAIA、xbench-DeepSearch 也有迁移增益，学习曲线显示更早起效、更快收敛；消融支持对数比 credit、适中的 turn-level 权重和中等 K-step 回传。需要注意，多数受控消融仅为单次训练，未报告方差调整后的结论。
brief.research_help: Insight：对长程 agent planning，可把“当前历史是否让可验证目标更容易被推出”作为局部进展势函数，而不是把整条轨迹统一奖惩。对多轮工具系统，K-step credit 表明早期搜索、选择与定位操作的价值常需由后续证据显现，奖励传播窗口应有限以避免把无关后续噪声倒灌给前序决策。对 planning reliability，终局 verifier 仍应保留为全局锚点；局部进展信号宜作为辅助项，而非替代最终正确性。

brief.abstract_zh: 多轮智能体在经历大量工具交互后才给出最终答案，因此后训练中的信用分配尤为困难；随着轨迹变长，终局奖励会变得稀疏、高方差，并会错罚失败轨迹中实际有帮助的动作。TRACE 提出一种面向 agentic RL 的稠密回报分配方法：在工具调用边界将轨迹表示为状态转移，用冻结参考模型对正确答案的对数概率构造对数比状态值，并以相邻状态值的 TD 变化作为逐动作奖励。该方法不需要额外 critic 或过程标签训练，其一步对数比 TD 项可在冗余工具调用间望远镜消去。长程复杂搜索实验表明，TRACE 仅依赖 RL 即可显著提升基础模型的工具使用能力，并在闭卷网页与开放网页基准上展现迁移和更快收敛。
brief.full_summary: 本文提出 TRACE，解决长程工具智能体只依赖最终成败奖励时，难以判断每一步检索、打开和定位操作是否真正有价值的问题。其核心是冻结一个参考模型，用轨迹各前缀条件下正确答案的可生成性估计局部状态价值，并以相邻价值的对数比变化为工具调用分配信用。方法同时保留 GRPO 的终局可验证奖励，因而局部“更像答案”的信号不会单独决定训练目标；有限 K-step 回传则把后续证据的收益适度传给早期检索动作。受控比较显示，它在闭卷长程搜索、开放网页检索和中文深搜基准上普遍优于 GRPO、GSPO 与 GiGRPO，并呈现更早的学习提升。阅读价值在于它给出了一种无需过程标注或训练 critic 的可操作长程 credit-assignment 配方，但当前证据主要覆盖短、可验证答案的搜索任务，对代码修复、开放式规划等长结构输出的可靠性仍未充分验证。
brief.card_summary: TRACE 用冻结参考模型衡量每次工具交互是否让正确答案更容易生成，并把这种局部进展转成逐回合 TD 奖励，再与终局验证奖励共同训练。它针对长程检索中“有用步骤被失败终局一并惩罚”的核心问题，在两种 Qwen3 骨干及多个深度搜索基准上均优于 outcome-only RL。

analysis.motivation: 长轨迹工具调用的终局奖励既稀疏又高方差：失败轨迹中可能包含有效检索，成功轨迹中也可能夹杂冗余操作，导致 outcome-only RL 无法准确区分每一步对最终答案的贡献。TRACE旨在在不引入过程标注、强评审模型或额外 critic 的前提下，为工具调用级决策提供更密的、仍受最终可验证答案约束的训练信号。
analysis.method: 将每条轨迹按工具调用边界切分为前缀状态；冻结的参考模型计算给定前缀时生成 gold answer 的平均对数概率，并将其转为相对初始“答案不确定性缺口”的对数比状态值。相邻状态值之差构成一步 TD credit，正值表示该工具动作及其观测使正确答案更可预测；再用有限窗口的 K-step 回传处理延迟生效的检索动作，并与 GRPO 的终局 outcome advantage 混合优化。该设计的单步项具有望远镜求和性质，理论上不会因插入冗余中间调用而累计获得额外总信用。
analysis.experiments: 在基于 OpenResearcher 离线语料构造的长链检索训练环境中，作者以 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 为骨干，最多允许 60 次工具调用，并与同条件的 GRPO、GSPO、GiGRPO 比较。闭卷网页 BrowseComp-Plus 上，TRACE 将 4B 从基础模型的 7.2 提升至 35.6，将 30B-A3B 从 8.4 提升至 42.6；相对 GRPO，四基准平均值分别由 29.5 提升至 34.0、由 32.5 提升至 38.1。开放网页 BrowseComp、GAIA、xbench-DeepSearch 也有迁移增益，学习曲线显示更早起效、更快收敛；消融支持对数比 credit、适中的 turn-level 权重和中等 K-step 回传。需要注意，多数受控消融仅为单次训练，未报告方差调整后的结论。

analysis.value_reason: 问题直击 agentic RL 的长程信用分配，方法结构简洁且与终局 verifier 明确耦合；在相同模型、数据和工具接口下相对多种 RL 基线有一致增益，也展示了跨检索环境与语言的迁移。风险在于状态价值依赖训练时已知的 gold answer 及冻结模型的概率代理，实验集中于合成训练与短答案搜索，部分消融为单次运行，因此其对更开放、结构化的 agent planning 任务是否稳定仍待复现。
analysis.limitations: 参考模型对 gold answer 的条件概率未必等同于真实任务进展，尤其在答案长、可接受解多或用户偏好未完全形式化时可能失真。训练与核心评测聚焦可精确验证的搜索问答，尚未证明能直接迁移到代码代理、多文件产物、开放式交互或长期记忆管理。外部深度研究系统的比较并非同数据、同训练流程的受控比较；受控消融多为单次训练，统计稳健性有限。
source_evidence: 论文将工具调用边界的前缀状态用冻结参考模型对正确答案的条件对数概率评分，并以对数比状态值的 TD 差分分配逐回合信用。
在同一骨干、浏览器接口、训练数据与终局奖励的受控设置下，TRACE 在两种 Qwen3 规模上均优于 GRPO、GSPO 和 GiGRPO。
作者明确限定方法当前主要适用于具有紧凑、可验证答案的长程搜索；长结构或开放式输出需要替代性的状态价值目标。

items.title: DREA: Decoupled Reasoning and Exploration Agents for Repository-Level Vulnerability Detection
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to vulnerability detection due to their strong code comprehension capabilities, but most existing approaches rely on isolated functions or context extracted by fixed program-analysis rules. These methods cannot adaptively explore repository-level dependencies to gather sufficient context when vulnerabilities span multiple functions or files, compromising detection reliability. We present DREA (Decoupled Reasoning and Exploration Agents), a hypothesis-driven framework for repository-level vulnerability detection. DREA decouples reasoning from exploration through two collaborating agents: a planning agent backed by an advanced LLM that forms vulnerability hypotheses and directs the investigation, and an explorer agent powered by a lightweight model that retrieves repository-level context on demand. Goal-directed context acquisition is the primary source of detection improvement in this design, while offloading token-heavy exploration to the local model keeps inference economically tractable. To support evaluation, we construct RepoPairBench, a repository-grounded benchmark of validated Python vulnerability-fix pairs from real-world projects. Beyond binary detection accuracy, we introduce a reasoning correctness evaluation to assess whether a model's rationale matches the documented vulnerability mechanism. Across three LLMs, DREA improves Pair-Correctness from 19-26% to 30-42% while offloading over 93% of tokens to the explorer, reducing estimated billable API cost by a factor of 16-48. Reasoning correctness analysis further reveals that 26-55% of true positives, for both DREA and the function-only baseline, are correct predictions supported by flawed rationales, identifying security reasoning quality as a shared bottleneck for current LLMs.

recommendation.label: 对多智能体长程取证与可靠性评估有参考价值
recommendation.value_judgement: 工作与 agentic RL 不直接相关，但其 Planner–Explorer 解耦、假设驱动探索、结构化证据回传及 Lucky Hit 诊断，能迁移到多轮 agent planning 和 long-horizon reliability 设计。实验对照和消融较完整，但数据集只有 100 个 Python 漏洞—修复对，部分细粒度结论样本较少。

brief.summary: 这篇论文研究跨文件漏洞往往无法由目标函数独立判断的问题，并将代码审计建模为围绕漏洞假设展开的多轮取证过程。DREA 让 Planner 决定需要查找哪些调用关系、校验逻辑或权限策略，再让本地 Explorer 负责仓库导航和结构化证据回传，最后由 Planner 形成判定与理由。作者在 100 组 Python CVE 漏洞—修复对上比较仅函数、整文件、单智能体和双智能体设置，双智能体在三种骨干模型上均取得更高的配对正确率。消融结果支持其核心主张：定向、结构化的探索比无差别扩大上下文或简单赋予工具访问更有效，也将大部分 token 成本移出付费推理模型。论文尤其有价值的一点是将结论正确与推理正确分开评估，显示大量真阳性并不真正理解漏洞根因；不过基准规模较小且仅覆盖 Python，结论仍需在更广泛代码生态中验证。

偏水风险：中
阅读来源：PDF 全文抽取
brief.motivation: 现有 LLM 漏洞检测多只看单个函数，或按固定规则补充上下文，难以发现跨函数、跨文件的授权、数据流和配置问题。论文将真实代码审计视为“先提出漏洞假设、再按需取证”的过程，目标是在不把整仓代码塞给昂贵模型的前提下提升仓库级检测可靠性。
brief.method: 提出 DREA 双智能体框架：强推理模型担任 Planner，从目标函数形成漏洞假设、规划下一步证据需求并作最终判定；轻量本地 Explorer 用 ls、glob、grep、read_file 等只读工具在仓库中导航，返回仓库上下文、代码证据和安全线索。作者构建 RepoPairBench，包含 2021–2025 年 Python CVE 的 100 组漏洞—修复函数对，并以修复前后对应的仓库快照评估；同时用 CVE、修复 diff、CWE 与模型理由核验解释是否真正符合漏洞机制，将“标签答对但理由错误”定义为 Lucky Hit。
brief.experiments: 在 RepoPairBench 的 200 个实例上，DREA 相比相同骨干的仅函数基线，三种模型的配对正确率均提升：DeepSeek-V3.2 从 19% 到 42%，GLM-4.7 从 26% 到 34%，GPT-5.2 从 21% 到 30%。消融显示，给单模型整文件或直接工具访问都不如 Planner–Explorer 分工，说明收益不只是更多上下文；Explorer 承担 93.7%–97.9% token，估计将付费 API 成本降至单模型方案的约 1/16–1/48。另一方面，26%–55% 的真阳性属于 Lucky Hit，更多探索 token 与预测正确性还呈弱负相关，表明瓶颈逐渐转向证据综合与安全推理质量。
brief.research_help: Insight：长程智能体不应把“规划判断”和“环境探索”混为同一上下文流。由高能力 Planner 维护可修订假设、把检索任务拆成有目标的证据请求，再由低成本 Explorer 执行环境交互并返回结构化、可追溯的观察，可同时降低上下文过载与交互成本。评估也应分离结果正确性与过程/理由可靠性：仅凭最终成功率会掩盖 Lucky Hit；对多轮系统可加入证据与任务机制的一致性判定，并将异常长轨迹视为困难信号而非自动追加交互预算的理由。

brief.full_summary: 这篇论文研究跨文件漏洞往往无法由目标函数独立判断的问题，并将代码审计建模为围绕漏洞假设展开的多轮取证过程。DREA 让 Planner 决定需要查找哪些调用关系、校验逻辑或权限策略，再让本地 Explorer 负责仓库导航和结构化证据回传，最后由 Planner 形成判定与理由。作者在 100 组 Python CVE 漏洞—修复对上比较仅函数、整文件、单智能体和双智能体设置，双智能体在三种骨干模型上均取得更高的配对正确率。消融结果支持其核心主张：定向、结构化的探索比无差别扩大上下文或简单赋予工具访问更有效，也将大部分 token 成本移出付费推理模型。论文尤其有价值的一点是将结论正确与推理正确分开评估，显示大量真阳性并不真正理解漏洞根因；不过基准规模较小且仅覆盖 Python，结论仍需在更广泛代码生态中验证。
brief.card_summary: DREA 将仓库级漏洞分析拆成“强模型提出并更新假设”与“轻量模型按需检索证据”，避免固定上下文检索和单智能体上下文膨胀。在 Python CVE 修复对基准上，它提高了配对检测正确率并显著降低付费模型 token，但也揭示不少正确标签只是理由错误的 Lucky Hit。

analysis.motivation: 现有 LLM 漏洞检测多只看单个函数，或按固定规则补充上下文，难以发现跨函数、跨文件的授权、数据流和配置问题。论文将真实代码审计视为“先提出漏洞假设、再按需取证”的过程，目标是在不把整仓代码塞给昂贵模型的前提下提升仓库级检测可靠性。
analysis.method: 提出 DREA 双智能体框架：强推理模型担任 Planner，从目标函数形成漏洞假设、规划下一步证据需求并作最终判定；轻量本地 Explorer 用 ls、glob、grep、read_file 等只读工具在仓库中导航，返回仓库上下文、代码证据和安全线索。作者构建 RepoPairBench，包含 2021–2025 年 Python CVE 的 100 组漏洞—修复函数对，并以修复前后对应的仓库快照评估；同时用 CVE、修复 diff、CWE 与模型理由核验解释是否真正符合漏洞机制，将“标签答对但理由错误”定义为 Lucky Hit。
analysis.experiments: 在 RepoPairBench 的 200 个实例上，DREA 相比相同骨干的仅函数基线，三种模型的配对正确率均提升：DeepSeek-V3.2 从 19% 到 42%，GLM-4.7 从 26% 到 34%，GPT-5.2 从 21% 到 30%。消融显示，给单模型整文件或直接工具访问都不如 Planner–Explorer 分工，说明收益不只是更多上下文；Explorer 承担 93.7%–97.9% token，估计将付费 API 成本降至单模型方案的约 1/16–1/48。另一方面，26%–55% 的真阳性属于 Lucky Hit，更多探索 token 与预测正确性还呈弱负相关，表明瓶颈逐渐转向证据综合与安全推理质量。
analysis.research_help: Insight：长程智能体不应把“规划判断”和“环境探索”混为同一上下文流。由高能力 Planner 维护可修订假设、把检索任务拆成有目标的证据请求，再由低成本 Explorer 执行环境交互并返回结构化、可追溯的观察，可同时降低上下文过载与交互成本。评估也应分离结果正确性与过程/理由可靠性：仅凭最终成功率会掩盖 Lucky Hit；对多轮系统可加入证据与任务机制的一致性判定，并将异常长轨迹视为困难信号而非自动追加交互预算的理由。

analysis.value_reason: 工作与 agentic RL 不直接相关，但其 Planner–Explorer 解耦、假设驱动探索、结构化证据回传及 Lucky Hit 诊断，能迁移到多轮 agent planning 和 long-horizon reliability 设计。实验对照和消融较完整，但数据集只有 100 个 Python 漏洞—修复对，部分细粒度结论样本较少。
analysis.limitations: 论文的主要实证范围是 100 组公开 CVE 关联的 Python 修复对，CWE 子类样本仅约 3–13 组，跨语言、长尾漏洞和真实部署泛化尚未验证。理由质量依赖 GPT-4.1 裁判，虽有 50 例专家标注校验，但仍可能受到裁判模型与有限人工样本的影响；修复版本被标为 benign 只表示原始 CVE 机制已修复，不等于代码不存在其他安全问题。

结果报告 DREA 的 Pair-Correctness 在三种骨干上从 19%–26% 提升到 30%–42%，且 93% 以上 token 由本地 Explorer 承担。
理由正确性分析显示，26%–55% 真阳性是 Lucky Hits：结论正确但漏洞机制解释错误。

items.title: Oracle Agent Memory as an Enterprise Memory Substrate for Long-Horizon AI Agents
items.summary: Agent memory is a systems problem for long-horizon agents. Practical deployments require retention of task state across extended conversations, recovery of user-specific facts and preferences across sessions, and accumulation of procedural knowledge from prior outcomes. These requirements extend beyond document retrieval: a memory layer must determine which interactions become durable state, how that state is scoped, how it is retrieved under latency constraints, and how it is revised or removed over time. This report studies Oracle Agent Memory as a database-native memory substrate built on Oracle Database. Three themes organize the discussion: memory as a lifecycle spanning ingestion, extraction, consolidation, retrieval, summarization, and revision or removal; a layered architecture that separates an active memory core from a passive memory-store interface with explicit scope control across users, agents, and threads; and evaluation methodology in which downstream task accuracy is complemented by memory-centric measures such as evidence retrieval, recall, latency, and estimated token use. The report summarizes LongMemEval results, reaching 93.8% accuracy, compares Oracle Agent Memory against flat-history baselines, using about 10.7x fewer tokens, and published or reported external baselines where available, and closes with implementation-oriented appendix material covering setup, thread lifecycle, and search semantics.

brief.summary: 论文提出 Oracle Agent Memory：以数据库为持久化、向量检索和治理底座，为长时程 Agent 管理对话状态、用户偏好和历史执行经验。其关键不只是检索历史文本，而是把记忆建模为“写入—抽取—整合—摘要—检索—修订/删除”的生命周期，并以用户、Agent、线程三层作用域约束可见性。架构上，主动层负责摘要、上下文卡、自动抽取和检索编排，被动层以统一记录模型保存原始消息与长期记忆，从而兼顾证据保留和紧凑提示上下文。实验显示该系统在 LongMemEval 的特定高配设置下取得 93.8% 准确率，并在脚本化长对话中明显降低估算输入 token；但多会话推理仍是相对薄弱项，且实验细节、外部基线和成本结论的可复现性有限。若关注多轮 Agent 的长期状态、记忆隔离和规划可靠性，这篇系统设计与评估框架值得细读。

brief.motivation: 论文将长时程 Agent 的记忆视为系统问题：不仅要保存对话，还要在跨会话场景中维护任务状态、用户偏好和从执行结果中沉淀的程序性经验，同时处理作用域、更新、遗忘、延迟与企业治理。
brief.method: 提出以 Oracle Database 为底座的分层记忆基座：主动记忆层负责消息同步、记忆抽取、摘要、上下文卡与检索编排；被动存储层提供持久化和作用域检索。系统区分工作记忆、长期事实记忆与程序/经验记忆，以 user、agent、thread 为一等作用域，并通过关系表、JSON、向量索引保存原始消息和提炼后的记忆；支持自动抽取与显式写入、摘要压缩和语义检索。
brief.experiments: 在 LongMemEval 上，文中报告特定配置下整体准确率为 93.8%，多会话推理是较弱类别（88.0%）。在 80 轮脚本对话中，系统估算每轮输入约 1,300 token，而平铺全历史约 13,900 token；与全历史基线的成对比较中记忆系统胜出更多。还报告了摘要阈值、提示缓存权衡及 BEAM 压力测试；不过这些结果依赖具体模型、提示、检索预算和裁判设置，部分外部基线并非同配置复现。
brief.research_help: Insight：长程规划系统应把“保存什么、在何种 user/agent/thread 作用域下可取回、何时修订或删除”作为显式策略，而不是把完整历史直接塞入上下文。对多轮可靠性而言，稳定的指令和工具定义宜保留在缓存友好的前缀，将易变的摘要、检索记忆和最新状态放在后部；同时分别评估任务正确率、证据召回、延迟、token 增长、更新冲突和拒答能力。程序性记忆尤其需要从执行结果中谨慎抽取并保留证据链，避免把噪声反馈固化为未来规划规则。

analysis.abstract_zh: Agent 记忆是长时程智能体中的系统性问题：实际部署既要在长对话中保留任务状态，也要跨会话找回用户事实与偏好，并从既往结果累积程序性知识。论文认为这超出了文档检索范畴，记忆层还必须决定哪些交互成为持久状态、其作用域为何、如何在延迟约束下检索，以及如何随时间修订或删除。文章以 Oracle Database 上的 Oracle Agent Memory 为对象，围绕记忆生命周期、主动记忆核心与被动存储接口分层架构，以及兼顾下游准确率、证据检索、召回、延迟和 token 使用量的评估方法展开。文中报告 LongMemEval 93.8% 准确率、相对平铺历史约少 10.7 倍 token，并附带实现、线程生命周期与检索语义材料。
analysis.card_summary: 这是一篇面向企业长时程 Agent 的记忆系统报告，将工作记忆、跨会话事实记忆和程序性经验记忆统一到数据库原生的生命周期与作用域管理中。它的价值在于把摘要、抽取、检索、修订、权限与成本放在同一系统设计里，并给出多轮记忆基准上的较强结果，但结论仍主要来自厂商自报配置。
analysis.full_summary: 论文提出 Oracle Agent Memory：以数据库为持久化、向量检索和治理底座，为长时程 Agent 管理对话状态、用户偏好和历史执行经验。其关键不只是检索历史文本，而是把记忆建模为“写入—抽取—整合—摘要—检索—修订/删除”的生命周期，并以用户、Agent、线程三层作用域约束可见性。架构上，主动层负责摘要、上下文卡、自动抽取和检索编排，被动层以统一记录模型保存原始消息与长期记忆，从而兼顾证据保留和紧凑提示上下文。实验显示该系统在 LongMemEval 的特定高配设置下取得 93.8% 准确率，并在脚本化长对话中明显降低估算输入 token；但多会话推理仍是相对薄弱项，且实验细节、外部基线和成本结论的可复现性有限。若关注多轮 Agent 的长期状态、记忆隔离和规划可靠性，这篇系统设计与评估框架值得细读。
analysis.value_label: 高相关的工程型记忆系统论文
analysis.value_reason: 与 agent memory、multi-turn agent、long-horizon reliability 和 planning state 管理直接相关，且覆盖作用域隔离、记忆生命周期、程序性记忆、检索质量与上下文成本等落地问题。风险在于它更像 Oracle 生态的系统报告，核心结果多为作者自报，实验配置和对照的完全复现信息不足。
analysis.limitations: 论文明确承认结果是特定模型、嵌入器、检索预算、提示和裁判配置下的测量，不能直接视为通用能力上限；部分外部基线仅作报告值比较而非同条件复现。LongMemEval 的多会话推理最低，BEAM 10M 压力测试中多会话推理和事件排序表现也较弱，说明超长轨迹中的跨会话整合与时间顺序仍是瓶颈。程序性记忆的可靠抽取、噪声/对抗反馈防护、冲突消解和自动遗忘仍多停留在设计目标或未来扩展层面。
source_evidence: 全文将记忆定义为包含抽取、整合、检索、摘要、修订与删除的生命周期，并区分工作、事实和程序/经验记忆。
架构以主动记忆核心和被动记忆存储接口分层，显式使用 user、agent、thread 作用域及精确匹配控制。
文中报告 LongMemEval 469/500、93.8% 准确率，最低类别为多会话推理 88.0%，并强调结果依赖具体评测配置。
80 轮比较中，文中估算 Agent Memory 约 1,300 输入 token、平铺历史约 13,900；BEAM 10M 测试则暴露多会话推理、事件排序与高 token 消耗等问题。

items.title: Omni-Decision: A Progressive Evidence-State Agent System for Omni-Modal QA
items.summary: Omni-modal evidence-seeking QA requires agents to answer questions whose evidence is sparsely distributed across videos, audio, images, web pages, and computation results. Existing agentic multimodal systems often leave evidence in scratchpads, tool trajectories, or free-form histories, making it difficult to track what has been grounded, what remains missing, and when the evidence is sufficient to answer. We propose Omni-Decision, a training-free evidence-state system that turns omni-modal QA into a query-scoped evidence-closure process. For each query, Omni-Decision maintains a structured evidence state containing confirmed evidence, unresolved conflicts, fact and computation dependencies, and open evidence needs. A shared state view conditions planning, evidence acquisition, validation, repair, and finalization. Heterogeneous observations from media, web, computation, and verification modules are normalized, judged, and committed through deterministic state updates. This design enables targeted evidence acquisition, preserves sparse cross-modal cues, and provides inspectable control over repair and stopping. Omni-Decision achieves 45.6% accuracy on OmniGAIA and 58.3% on WorldSense, improving over the baselines by +27.3 and +30.2 percentage points, respectively. No-state ablations and trajectory audits further support the role of explicit evidence-state control in multi-step omni-modal evidence seeking.

recommendation.label: 值得优先阅读
recommendation.value_judgement: 问题设定与 agent planning、长程可靠性高度相关，且方法提供了可直接复用的状态接口、写入约束和停止条件，而非泛泛的多 agent 编排。实验包含跨任务迁移、后端替换、去状态诊断和轨迹审计，证据链比只报最终准确率更完整；不过比较依赖特定强模型与工具栈，状态消融只覆盖固定子集，运行成本也明显高于 base agent，因此应将性能结论视为有力但仍待更全面复现的系统证据。

brief.summary: 这篇论文提出 Omni-Decision，试图解决多模态、多跳问答中证据散落于媒体、网页与计算工具、而 agent 又容易在长轨迹里遗失任务状态的问题。其核心不是训练新模型或增加角色，而是以查询级结构化状态统一承载已确认的证据、未解决冲突、外部事实和计算依赖，以及仍待满足的证据需求。规划、验证、修复和最终回答都读取该状态，工具产出只能通过标准化 reducer 写回；回答必须满足所有需求闭合、依赖完成且无冲突。文中在 OmniGAIA 上报告明显优于其受控 agent 基线的结果，并用去状态消融提供了显式状态带来额外收益的信号；WorldSense 的迁移结果说明该接口并非只适用于开放网页检索。对长程 agent 而言，最有价值的是把“是否继续找证据、修复还是停止”转成可检查的状态条件，但其结果也受感知后端和工具调用成本影响，尚缺少更强的成本—准确率与重复运行证据。

偏水风险：中
阅读来源：PDF 全文抽取
brief.motivation: 论文聚焦跨视频、音频、图像、网页与计算结果的多跳问答：关键证据稀疏地分散在不同模态中，且系统需要持续判断已确认内容、待补事实、冲突与何时可安全作答。作者认为单纯扩大上下文或保留自由形式轨迹，无法可靠地维护这些面向当前问题的证据关系，因此将问题重述为“证据闭合”的状态维护与控制问题。
brief.method: Omni-Decision 是一个免训练的推理时系统，围绕每个问题维护查询范围内的显式证据状态：已确认证据、未解决冲突、外部事实与计算依赖、开放证据需求。规划器、工具、批评器和最终回答模块都读取同一份状态摘要；工具输出先被标准化，只有 reducer 能按确定性的字段更新规则写入状态。系统根据未闭合槽位选择感知、检索、浏览、计算或验证动作；只有开放需求为空、依赖完成且无冲突时才允许完成，否则在无可推进动作时返回证据不足。
brief.experiments: 在 OmniGAIA 的 360 个样本上，系统报告 45.6% 准确率，高于同文复现实验中的官方 base agent 18.3% 与 OmniAgent 25.5%。固定 120 个样本的去状态消融中，默认配置从 41.7% 降至 32.5%，表明增益并非仅来自规划器或感知后端；但该消融规模较小，未给出多次运行方差。迁移到封闭式音视频选择题 WorldSense 时达到 58.3%，低于最强原生端到端参考模型 65.5%；轨迹审计显示错误案例常已完成部分证据链，但仍会卡在感知、检索、计算或停止判断。
brief.research_help: Insight：把长期任务中的工作记忆实现为“可读、受控写入、可验证”的任务级证据账本，可让规划、工具调用、反思、修复与停止共享同一事实边界。对于多轮或长程 agent，关键不是累积更多轨迹文本，而是显式记录未完成槽位、依赖、来源与冲突，并把最终行动或回答绑定到闭合条件。该范式也提示可将可靠性评估从最终成败扩展到证据覆盖、冲突定位、未闭合依赖和恰当弃答。

brief.abstract_zh: 全模态证据检索式问答需要智能体整合视频、音频、图像、网页和计算结果中稀疏分布的证据。现有多模态智能体常把证据留在 scratchpad、工具轨迹或自由文本历史中，难以追踪哪些事实已经落地、哪些信息仍缺失，以及证据何时足以回答。本文提出免训练的 Omni-Decision，将任务建模为面向查询的证据闭合过程，并维护确认事实、未解冲突、事实和计算依赖及开放证据需求组成的结构化状态。共享状态驱动规划、证据获取、验证、修复和最终作答，异构观察经标准化和确定性更新后写入状态。系统在 OmniGAIA 与 WorldSense 上分别达到 45.6% 和 58.3% 准确率，作者还通过去状态消融和轨迹审计支持显式证据状态控制的作用。

analysis.abstract_zh: 全模态证据检索式问答需要智能体整合视频、音频、图像、网页和计算结果中稀疏分布的证据。现有多模态智能体常把证据留在 scratchpad、工具轨迹或自由文本历史中，难以追踪哪些事实已经落地、哪些信息仍缺失，以及证据何时足以回答。本文提出免训练的 Omni-Decision，将任务建模为面向查询的证据闭合过程，并维护确认事实、未解冲突、事实和计算依赖及开放证据需求组成的结构化状态。共享状态驱动规划、证据获取、验证、修复和最终作答，异构观察经标准化和确定性更新后写入状态。系统在 OmniGAIA 与 WorldSense 上分别达到 45.6% 和 58.3% 准确率，作者还通过去状态消融和轨迹审计支持显式证据状态控制的作用。
analysis.card_summary: Omni-Decision 将多模态 agent 的核心控制对象从自由工具轨迹改为任务级“证据状态”，显式追踪已证实事实、缺口、依赖与冲突，并用闭合条件决定何时作答。它在 OmniGAIA 上相对文中基线有较大提升，值得关注其对长程证据搜集和可靠停止的系统设计启发。
analysis.full_summary: 这篇论文提出 Omni-Decision，试图解决多模态、多跳问答中证据散落于媒体、网页与计算工具、而 agent 又容易在长轨迹里遗失任务状态的问题。其核心不是训练新模型或增加角色，而是以查询级结构化状态统一承载已确认的证据、未解决冲突、外部事实和计算依赖，以及仍待满足的证据需求。规划、验证、修复和最终回答都读取该状态，工具产出只能通过标准化 reducer 写回；回答必须满足所有需求闭合、依赖完成且无冲突。文中在 OmniGAIA 上报告明显优于其受控 agent 基线的结果，并用去状态消融提供了显式状态带来额外收益的信号；WorldSense 的迁移结果说明该接口并非只适用于开放网页检索。对长程 agent 而言，最有价值的是把“是否继续找证据、修复还是停止”转成可检查的状态条件，但其结果也受感知后端和工具调用成本影响，尚缺少更强的成本—准确率与重复运行证据。
analysis.value_label: 值得优先阅读
analysis.value_reason: 问题设定与 agent planning、长程可靠性高度相关，且方法提供了可直接复用的状态接口、写入约束和停止条件，而非泛泛的多 agent 编排。实验包含跨任务迁移、后端替换、去状态诊断和轨迹审计，证据链比只报最终准确率更完整；不过比较依赖特定强模型与工具栈，状态消融只覆盖固定子集，运行成本也明显高于 base agent，因此应将性能结论视为有力但仍待更全面复现的系统证据。
analysis.limitations: 论文不学习状态表示或策略，低层感知、检索质量和预算分配仍是主要瓶颈；在 OmniGAIA 上平均工具请求显著增加，缺少统一的时延、成本与准确率权衡。关键消融在 120 个固定样本上进行，主结果仅固定配置单次运行，未报告跨随机种子稳定性。人工进度审计样本有限，且独立模型审计对错误案例给出更宽松的进度判断，说明过程指标会受评审标准影响。
source_evidence: 方法部分明确将证据状态划分为已确认证据 E、冲突 C、事实/计算依赖 F 与开放需求 U，并规定 reducer 为唯一写入者。
OmniGAIA 主表报告 Omni-Decision 为 45.56%，同文 OmniGAIA base 为 18.33%、OmniAgent 为 25.51%；固定子集去状态后默认配置从 41.67% 降至 32.50%。
WorldSense 表报告 Omni-Decision 为 58.32%，而最强公开端到端参考 Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 为 65.50%。
附录显示 Omni-Decision 在 OmniGAIA 上记录 4,038 次工具请求、平均每题 11.22 次，高于 base agent 的平均 2.45 次。

items.title: GRASP: GRanularity-Aware Search Policy for Agentic RAG
items.summary: GRASP 把 agentic RAG 中“何时检索、用什么检索、展开多大上下文”建成可学习策略。它用 RL 训练 agent 在语义搜索、关键词搜索和段落阅读之间切换，并在多跳推理 benchmark 上提升检索召回与问答表现。

recommendation.label: 强烈推荐
recommendation.value_judgement: 强相关：直接覆盖 agentic RAG、multi-step reasoning 与 RL policy learning，关注检索工具选择和上下文粒度控制；摘要有多跳 benchmark、baseline、ablation 证据。
recommendation.reason: 强相关：直接覆盖 agentic RAG、multi-step reasoning 与 RL policy learning，关注检索工具选择和上下文粒度控制；摘要有多跳 benchmark、baseline、ablation 证据。

brief.contribution: 提出 granularity-aware search policy，用奖励同时优化答案正确性、grounded reading、互补检索与 turn efficiency。
brief.summary: 静态 RAG 或 prompting agentic RAG 很难判断什么时候检索、检索哪种证据、何时展开上下文。GRASP 将语义搜索、关键词搜索和段落阅读作为可组合动作，用 RL 训练检索策略，在多跳推理任务中学习“先粗搜、再局部核验、必要时实体检索”的行为。
highlights: 非机器人，直接服务多步 agent reasoning。
把上下文粒度作为 policy 控制变量，而不是固定 top-k 检索。
有多跳 benchmark、RL retrieval baseline 和消融信号。
brief.motivation: Agentic RAG 需要在多步推理过程中反复检索，但无约束检索会带来无关 token 干扰和 turn 浪费。论文动机是让 agent 学会按任务状态选择检索工具和证据粒度。
brief.method: 方法把 semantic search、keyword search、paragraph reading 设为动作空间，奖励同时考虑答案准确、证据 grounding、互补检索和回合效率，从而训练 granularity-aware retrieval policy。
brief.experiments: 摘要报告在 multi-hop reasoning benchmarks 上，相比 single-step retrieval、prompting-based agentic RAG 和 RL-based retrieval baselines，同时提升 retrieval recall 与 downstream QA；定性和消融显示策略形成可解释的 skimming/scanning 行为。
brief.research_help: Insight：对于 long-horizon agent，检索不是一次性上下文拼接，而是可按子目标、证据缺口和验证需求动态路由的动作。可借鉴其 reward，把 task success、证据质量、上下文成本和 turn cost 一起纳入 agentic RL。
